domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: GDI High-Pressure Fuel Rail Low — Worn HPFP Cam Follower
phContext: Honda Civic/CR-V 1.5T, Ford EcoBoost, Hyundai GDI; overdue 5W-30/0W-20 oil
symptoms: Hard start hot, power cut above 3500 RPM, rattling noise from HPFP
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare low-side lift pressure (400–550 kPa) vs. GDI rail pressure (4–20 MPa). 2. Remove cam-driven HPFP and inspect roller tappet/cam lobe for flat-spotting. 3. Replace worn follower & pump.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: GDI High-Pressure Fuel Rail Too High — Stuck Spill Valve
phContext: Mazda Skyactiv-G, Hyundai GDI, Geely 1.5T; varnished internal HPFP solenoid
symptoms: Rough idle, black smoke, fuel trim <-20%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor Desired vs. Actual GDI Rail Pressure PID at idle. 2. Scope HPFP quantity control solenoid PWM pulse. 3. Replace HPFP assembly if spill valve sticks closed.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Turbo-Gasoline Underboost — Electronic Wastegate Linkage Wear
phContext: Honda 1.5T, Ford 1.0/1.5 EcoBoost, Geely Coolray; loose wastegate rod
symptoms: Rattling sound on decel, sluggish overtaking, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect turbocharger external wastegate actuator arm for axial play/rattle. 2. Command wastegate position via scan tool and check 5V position sensor feedback. 3. Adjust or replace actuator.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Turbo-Gasoline Overboost — Torn Blow-Off / Bypass Valve Diaphragm
phContext: MG ZS T, Ford EcoBoost, Subaru; boost spike on throttle lift
symptoms: Compressor surge flutter, sudden throttle cut, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove diverter/bypass valve on turbo housing and inspect rubber diaphragm for tears. 2. Check boost control solenoid vacuum hoses for splits. 3. Test solenoid resistance (20– 35 ohms).

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: GDI Cold-Start Misfire — Intake Valve Carbon Coking
phContext: GDI sedans/crossovers >60,000 km in Metro Manila traffic (no port wash)
symptoms: Shaking idle for first 30 sec cold, clears once warm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Borescope intake ports behind valves to inspect heavy black carbon stalactites. 2. Perform walnut-shell blasting of intake valves. 3. Check PCV oil separator to reduce oil vapor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Knock Sensor Range/Performance — Low-Speed Pre-Ignition (LSPI)
phContext: Small-displacement turbo GDI running RON 91 fuel in high heat
symptoms: Metallic ping/rattle on uphill load at 1800 RPM, timing pulled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fuel octane used (advise RON 95+ and API SP / ILSAC GF-6 oil to prevent LSPI!). 2. Read Knock Retard PID under load. 3. Inspect spark plugs for cracked ceramic or pre-ignition speckles.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: VVT Crank/Cam Correlation — Stretched Timing Belt-in-Oil (Wet Belt)
phContext: Ford 1.0 EcoBoost (Fiesta/EcoSport); degraded wet timing belt
symptoms: Rattling at cold start, oil pressure warning, P0016
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drop oil pan and inspect oil pickup screen for shredded rubber belt fibers! 2. Check cam/crank phase on oscilloscope. 3. Replace wet timing belt using OEM timing pins and clean pickup.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Crank/Exhaust Cam Correlation — Stuck Exhaust VVT Phaser
phContext: Dual-VVT Toyota (2NR-FE/2ZR-FE), Hyundai Nu/Gamma
symptoms: Rattle on cold start for 2 sec, rough idle, stalls at stops
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil level and viscosity (thick 20W-50 sludge jams VVT phasers!). 2. Command exhaust OCV duty cycle via scan tool; verify phase moves 0–40°. 3. Replace noisy cam phaser.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Intake Camshaft Actuator Circuit Open — Chafed OCV Plug
phContext: Honda, Toyota, Mitsubishi MIVEC; brittle plastic plug on cylinder head
symptoms: MIL on, sluggish mid-range torque
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure OCV coil resistance (7–12 ohms). 2. Check 12V IG1 feed and ECM PWM ground pulse with test light/scope. 3. Replace cracked OCV pigtail.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Intake Camshaft Actuator Bank 2 — V6 Oil Control Valve
phContext: Toyota Fortuner/Camry/Alphard V6 (2GR-FE); rear bank OCV fault
symptoms: Rough idle on Bank 2, MIL + VSC lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Swap Bank 2 OCV with Bank 1 if accessible, or ohm-test coil (7–8 ohms). 2. Clean metal mesh oil filter bolt feeding Bank 2 VVT head. 3. Check wiring.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: GDI Catalytic Converter Efficiency Low — Oil Dilution / Short Trips
phContext: GDI crossovers used for 5 km daily school runs
symptoms: MIL on, fuel smell in engine oil
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check engine oil dipstick for high level / gasoline odor. 2. Compare B1S1 wideband AFR vs. B1S2 O2 switching. 3. Change oil and perform highway Italian tune-up before condemning cat.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: GDI Lean Trim — Cracked PCV Valve Diaphragm in Valve Cover
phContext: MG, Geely, Ford, Chevrolet/Hyundai turbo; torn integrated PCV
symptoms: Loud whistling noise from engine, rough idle, sucks oil cap down hard
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull oil dipstick or cap at idle; extreme vacuum + whistle stops = torn PCV diaphragm! 2. Inspect rear main seal for vacuum-induced leak. 3. Replace valve cover/PCV assembly.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Fuel Delivery Error — Vapor Lock in Hot Traffic
phContext: Older EFI/GDI cars with weak in-tank pump + 40°C ambient
symptoms: Stumbles/stalls after 1 hour in traffic, restarts after cooling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect fuel pressure gauge and monitor pressure during hot-soak idle. 2. Check fuel tank vent/purge system (excess tank vacuum causes boiling). 3. Replace weak in-tank pump.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Engine Overspeed Condition — Missed Downshift (Manual)
phContext: Manual sports/hatchbacks; accidental 4th-to-2nd downshift
symptoms: MIL/wrench light stored in freeze frame, normal driving after
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read freeze-frame RPM (e.g., 7,400+ RPM). 2. Inspect valve train noise and perform compression test to rule out bent valves. 3. Clear history code if mechanicals pass.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Exhaust CMP Sensor B Circuit — Heat-Fatigued Hall Sensor
phContext: Toyota 2NR-FE, Nissan HR12/MR20, Hyundai; hot exhaust-side sensor
symptoms: Extended cranking when hot, stalls at stoplight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor Exhaust CMP PID during hot no-start. 2. Check 5V/12V supply and ground at sensor. 3. Scope CMP signal vs. CKP; replace heat-sensitive sensor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cold Start Camshaft Timing Over-Advanced — VVT Lock Pin
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Kia GDI; worn VVT phaser locking pin bore
symptoms: Rattle on cold start, MIL on first drive of day
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil pressure at cold start. 2. Monitor Desired vs. Actual Cam Angle during first 10 seconds of cold start. 3. Replace intake VVT phaser.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Internal Control Module Torque Calculation — Boost/MAF Mismatch
phContext: Ford EcoBoost, Geely, MG; aftermarket air intake or boost leak
symptoms: Sudden limp mode under WOT, wrench light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove aftermarket cone filter / oiled filter and inspect MAF/MAP correlation. 2. Pressure-test charge pipes for boost leak. 3. Reset KAM and test.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Supercharger/Intake Flap Actuator Fault — Carbon Jam
phContext: European/modern turbo-gasoline; intake runner flap stuck
symptoms: Loss of low-end torque, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Actuate intake runner control via scan tool. 2. Inspect external linkage for broken plastic clip. 3. Clean carbon from runner flaps.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Post-Catalyst Fuel Trim Too Lean — Exhaust Flex Pipe Leak
phContext: Front-wheel-drive sedans hitting speed bumps; cracked exhaust flex braid
symptoms: Exhaust buzz under floor, P2096/P0136, false lean trim
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect exhaust flex pipe and flange gaskets between B1S1 and B1S2 O2 sensors for black soot marks. 2. Smoke-test exhaust cold. 3. Weld new flex pipe.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: System Too Lean Off Idle — Weak High-Pressure Fuel Delivery
phContext: GDI/MPI cars; clogged in-tank fuel filter sock (never serviced >80k km)
symptoms: Idle trims fine (0%), trims jump +20% above 2500 RPM under load
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor STFT/LTFT at idle vs. 3000 RPM road load. 2. Check fuel pressure under WOT load (drops below spec). 3. Replace in-tank fuel filter module.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: System Too Lean at Idle — Purge Valve Stuck Open
phContext: Hyundai, Kia, Ford, Mazda; EVAP purge solenoid leaking vapor/air
symptoms: Rough idle, LTFT +18% at idle, normal at highway cruise
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pinch EVAP purge hose at intake manifold at idle; if STFT drops rapidly toward 0%, purge valve is stuck open! 2. Replace purge solenoid.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: System Too Rich at Idle — Fuel-Diluted Oil / Leaking HPFP Seal
phContext: Honda 1.5T, Mazda Skyactiv, Hyundai GDI; HPFP plunger seal leak
symptoms: Oil level above max on dipstick, strong gas smell, LTFT -18% idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil level/smell (fuel leaks past HPFP shaft directly into crankcase!). 2. Pull PCV hose; if trims normalize, crankcase is full of fuel vapor. 3. Replace HPFP and change oil.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Turbo Bypass Valve Mechanical Fault — Sticking Piston
phContext: Turbo gasoline crossovers; oil mist gumming diverter piston
symptoms: Turbo flutter noise, power lag between shifts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove electronic/vacuum bypass valve and check piston movement. 2. Test actuator coil resistance and 12V feed. 3. Replace diverter valve.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: O2 Sensor B1S2 Signal Biased Lean — Exhaust Pinholes
phContext: Coastal PH sedans; rusted muffler/mid-pipe flange
symptoms: MIL on, normal engine performance
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check B1S2 voltage (stuck <0.2V). 2. Plug tailpipe briefly with rag while engine idles to hear exhaust leaks upstream of B1S2. 3. Repair exhaust flange.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: ECM/PCM Internal Engine Off Timer — Low Battery / Flash
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Ford; battery disconnected or dying 12V cell
symptoms: MIL on after overnight park, engine runs fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare Engine Off Timer PID vs. actual soak time. 2. Load-test 12V battery. 3. Check for OEM ECU calibration update.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: A/F Sensor (Wideband) Heater Low — B1S1 Shorted
phContext: Toyota Vios/Altis/Fortuner Gas, Honda; wideband heater element short
symptoms: MIL on immediately, open-loop fuel consumption
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure wideband A/F sensor heater pins (typically 2–4 ohms; <0.5 ohms = shorted). 2. Check A/F Heater relay/fuse. 3. Replace OEM Denso/NGK wideband sensor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: MAP Sensor Circuit High — Open Ground / Unplugged
phContext: Honda City/BR-V, Suzuki Ertiga; forgotten plug after service
symptoms: Black smoke, stalls at idle, MAP reads 105+ kPa running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read MAP PID at idle (must be 28– 36 kPa; 101+ kPa running = open ground or dead sensor). 2. Check 5V and sensor ground continuity. 3. Reconnect/replace MAP.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: IAT Sensor Circuit Low — Shorted Sensor / Pinched Wire
phContext: All EFI/GDI engines; IAT reads +120°C+ constant
symptoms: Sluggish hot-weather power (excessive timing retard)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read IAT PID at cold start (should match ambient ~30°C). 2. Unplug MAF/IAT sensor; if PID drops to -40°C, sensor is shorted internally. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: O2 Sensor B1S1 Circuit — Contaminated by Silicone / Coolant
phContext: Engines after head gasket/valve cover job using cheap non-sensor-safe RTV
symptoms: White silica crust on O2 tip, lazy switching, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove B1S1 O2 sensor and inspect tip for white/pink glassy coating. 2. Scope response time (rich-to-lean must be <100 ms). 3. Replace sensor and use O2-safe RTV only.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Fuel Trim Malfunction Bank 1 — Combined MAF/O2/Fuel Skew
phContext: Mitsubishi, Mercedes/BMW, Suzuki; trim hit +/- 25% rail
symptoms: Poor fuel mileage, rough idle, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check STFT + LTFT sum at idle vs. 2500 RPM. 2. Inspect air filter, fuel pressure, and exhaust leaks. 3. Reset trims after repair.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cylinder 2 Injector Circuit — High-Voltage GDI Driver Fault
phContext: GDI engines (65V boost injector driver); open/shorted coil
symptoms: Dead cylinder #2, ECM shuts down bank or cylinder fuel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure GDI injector coil resistance (typically 1.2–2.5 ohms!). 2. Check insulation to ground (>10 MΩ). 3. Scope high-voltage peak-and-hold current.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cylinder 5 Misfire — V6 Rear Bank Ignition Coil
phContext: Toyota Camry/Alphard/Fortuner V6, Nissan VQ; hidden under plenum
symptoms: Shaking at idle in Drive, MIL flashing under load
diagnosticSteps: 1. Identify Cylinder #5 location per OEM firing order. 2. Check rear bank coil 12V/GND/IGT before pulling plenum. 3. Replace all rear plugs/coils together to save labor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cylinder 6 Misfire — V6 Valve Cover Oil Leak into Plug Well
phContext: Older V6 sedans/SUVs; hardened spark plug tube seals
symptoms: Misfire on #6, coil boot soaked in engine oil
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull coil #6 and look down spark plug tube for pooled engine oil. 2. Clean oil, replace valve cover gasket + tube seals. 3. Replace oil-swollen coil boot & spark plug.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: CKP Sensor Intermittent — Flywheel Tone Wheel Runout
phContext: Cars after clutch/flywheel replacement; bent reluctor plate
symptoms: Random bucking at 3000 RPM, tach flickers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope CKP waveform at 2000–3000 RPM; look for amplitude wobble or missing pulses. 2. Inspect reluctor teeth through bellhousing/sensor hole. 3. Replace damaged tone wheel.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: CMP Sensor Range/Performance — Loose Cam Trigger Bolt
phContext: Engines after cylinder head/camshaft repair
symptoms: Extended cranking, erratic timing, P0341
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope CMP signal against CKP. 2. Check CMP sensor mounting (air gap too wide from missing O-ring/shimmed bolt). 3. Inspect cam reluctor wheel.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Warm-Up Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold — Short Trips
phContext: Mitsubishi Xpander/Mirage, Mazda; close-coupled manifold cat
symptoms: MIL on after 30,000+ km city crawling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check for exhaust manifold cracks near upstream O2. 2. Compare B1S1 vs. B1S2 waveforms at hot 2500 RPM. 3. Verify no oil burning or rich misfires.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Catalyst System Efficiency Bank 2 — V6 Bank 2 Cat
phContext: V6 SUVs/vans; Bank 2 misfire history damaging cat
symptoms: MIL on, normal driveability
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Bank 2 fuel trims and misfire history first. 2. Compare B2S1 vs. B2S2 O2 waveforms. 3. Inspect for Bank 2 exhaust leak before replacing cat.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cold Start Idle Air Control Performance — Carbon/VVT
phContext: GDI/MPI cars; fails to hold high cold-start idle (1400 RPM)
symptoms: Stumbles or stalls for first 10 sec on cold morning start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean electronic throttle body bore and reset learned idle. 2. Check ECT accuracy at cold start. 3. Inspect intake manifold for small vacuum leak.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Cold Start Ignition Timing Performance — Spark/Carbon
phContext: Modern Euro-4/5 gasoline cars; retarded cat-heating timing misfires
symptoms: Rough cold idle during first 20 sec, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect spark plugs for wear/gap >1.1 mm. 2. Check fuel quality (stale E10). 3. Clean throttle body and intake valves.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Incorrect Immobilizer Key — Quick-Turn Cranking
phContext: Push-start or transponder keys turned too rapidly or weak battery
symptoms: Stored P0513, car may fail to start on first try
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test key fob battery and spare key. 2. Inspect ignition antenna ring connection. 3. Clear history code and test 10 starts.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Thermostat Heater Control Circuit Open — Map-Controlled Stat
phContext: European/Ford/Chevrolet/modern crossovers; wax-heater element open
symptoms: MIL on, cooling fan runs high, slightly warmer running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure resistance of 2-pin electrical connector on thermostat housing (spec 10–20 ohms). 2. Check 12V supply fuse. 3. Replace electronically assisted thermostat.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Serial Communication Link — ECM-to-Sub-CPU Internal Fault
phContext: Nissan/Mitsubishi/Toyota; moisture or solder fatigue inside ECM
symptoms: Limp mode, multiple phantom faults
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify all ECM external powers and grounds under load. 2. Check alternator AC ripple (<50 mV). 3. Replace/clone ECM if internal.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Sensor Reference Voltage A Low (<4.5V) — Shorted 5V Sensor
phContext: Any modern EFI/GDI; one shorted 5V sensor (AC/MAP/FRP) kills all
symptoms: Multiple sensor codes at once (MAP + APP + AC pressure!), no start/limp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 5V VREF at any accessible 3-pin sensor (reads <3V). 2. Unplug 5V sensors ONE BY ONE while watching VREF; when 5V snaps back, that sensor (or its wire) is shorted! 3. Replace shorted sensor.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Sensor Reference Voltage A High (>5.5V) — Short to 12V
phContext: Pinched wiring harness rubbing 5V wire against 12V ignition wire
symptoms: Sensors reading maxed out, risk of frying ECM 5V regulator
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately check 5V VREF pin with DMM (if >5.5V, find where 12V is bleeding into 5V!). 2. Inspect recently repaired connectors/harnesses. 3. Repair wire short before replacing sensors.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Sensor Reference Voltage B Low — Throttle/Pedal 5V Rail
phContext: Dual-5V-regulator ECMs; shorted APP2 or Oil/Fuel pressure sensor
symptoms: Limp mode, pedal dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug sensors on VREF-B bus one by one until 5.0V returns. 2. Inspect underbody/transmission pressure sensor plugs for water short. 3. Repair.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: MAF Sensor Out of Self-Test Range — Aftermarket Intake
phContext: Turbo/EFI cars with oiled cone filter or loose intake clamp
symptoms: MIL on, sluggish throttle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect intake tube between airbox and throttle for unsealed clamps or torn accordion boot. 2. Restore OEM paper air filter. 3. Clean MAF.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Intake Manifold Runner Control Stuck Open — Broken Link
phContext: Honda/Hyundai/Ford/Maz da; plastic swirl runner arm popped off
symptoms: Loss of low-end torque below 3000 RPM, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Visually inspect IMRC vacuum/electric actuator arm behind/under intake manifold. 2. Command IMRC open/closed via scan tool. 3. Reattach or replace bushing/actuator.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Throttle Actuator Control Stuck Open — Jammed Butterfly
phContext: Cars with carbon/ice or stripped plastic gear in ETC
symptoms: Engine races to 3000+ RPM or shuts down via safety fuel cut
diagnosticSteps: 1. Key off: gently press throttle plate to check for mechanical jam. 2. Inspect ETC plastic gear teeth under black cap. 3. Clean or replace throttle body.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: Bank 1 Air-Fuel Ratio Imbalance — Single Weak Injector
phContext: Modern Euro-5/6 cars; one cylinder running 15% leaner/richer
symptoms: Smooth-feeling engine with MIL on, failed emission
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Mode $06 cylinder-by-cylinder O2 imbalance counters. 2. Perform injector flow balance test and compression check. 3. Clean/replace outlier injector.

domainName: Gasoline GDI, Turbo-Gasoline & VVT/Valvetrain Faults
title: O2/AF Sensor Pumping Current Circuit Open (B1S1)
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Subaru wideband A/F sensor; broken wire or dead sensor
symptoms: MIL on, A/F lambda stuck at 1.00, poor MPG
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 4/6-pin wideband connector for water/pin back-out. 2. Check continuity of Ip/Vs wires to ECM. 3. Replace wideband A/F sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: SCR NOx Catalyst Efficiency Below Threshold — Poor AdBlue
phContext: Euro-5/6 vans/SUVs (Staria, Everest, Ranger, European diesels)
symptoms: Countdown 'No Restart in 800 km', AdBlue warning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test AdBlue/DEF urea concentration with refractometer (must be 32.5%; water/diluted DEF triggers P20EE!). 2. Inspect DEF injector tip for white crystallization. 3. Drain tank and refill ISO 22241 DEF.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Reductant (AdBlue) System Performance — Clogged DEF Injector
phContext: Diesel vans/SUVs in short-trip urban delivery
symptoms: MIL + AdBlue warning, countdown active
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove DEF dosing injector at exhaust pipe and check for rock-hard white urea crystal buildup. 2. Run DEF dosing quantity test into graduated beaker via scan tool. 3. Clean/replace injector.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Reductant Pressure Too Low — Failed DEF Pump / Heater
phContext: Euro-5/6 diesels; crystallized urea jamming diaphragm pump
symptoms: AdBlue fault immediately at startup
diagnosticSteps: 1. Command DEF pump pressure test via scan tool (spec ~500–900 kPa). 2. Check DEF tank strainer for crystal sludge. 3. Replace DEF pump module.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: NOx Sensor Circuit (Bank 1) — Moisture/Thermal Shock
phContext: Euro-5/6 diesels crossing deep puddles with hot exhaust
symptoms: MIL + AdBlue warning, NOx PID stuck
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read NOx Upstream vs. Downstream ppm PIDs (must read ~0 ppm at key-off, rise with load). 2. Inspect underbody NOx control box for water ingress. 3. Replace NOx sensor & reset learned values.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: 2.0 Bi-Turbo Wet Timing Belt Degradation (Ford Ranger/Everest)
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest 2.0 EcoBlue/Bi-Turbo >100,000 km or wrong oil
symptoms: Rattle, low oil pressure light, P0016
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain oil and inspect sump pickup strainer for rubber belt debris (wrong oil spec dissolves wet belt!). 2. Check belt width/teeth via oil filler/cover. 3. Replace wet belt + oil pump belt with WSS-M2C950-A oil.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Cylinder 1 Fuel Injector Offset Learning at Max Limit
phContext: Ford 2.0/2.2/3.2, Isuzu 4JJ3, Mitsubishi 4N15; worn piezo/solenoid
symptoms: Diesel knock under light throttle, rough idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check injector pilot learn counters and return flow. 2. Verify fuel filter cleanliness. 3. Replace drifting injector, code IMA, and run pilot learn.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Cylinder 2 Injector Offset Learning at Min Limit
phContext: Over-fueling / dripping injector #2 tip
symptoms: Black smoke puffs, knocking cylinder #2
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check cylinder #2 balance PID (negative correction). 2. Pull injector #2 for nozzle test. 3. Replace injector and reset learned offsets.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Turbocharger Boost Control Solenoid Range — Dual-Stage Turbo
phContext: Ford 2.0 Bi-Turbo, Mazda 2.2 Skyactiv-D; sticking changeover flap
symptoms: No low-end boost below 2000 RPM, wrench light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect HP/LP turbo changeover actuator vacuum lines and position sensor. 2. Check plastic intake manifold for hairline pressure cracks! 3. Test actuator sweep.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGR Temperature Sensor A Circuit High — Soot/Open
phContext: Toyota 1GD/2GD, Isuzu 4JJ3, Ford; post-EGR cooler temp sensor
symptoms: MIL on, DPF regen inhibited
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read EGR Gas Temp PID at cold KOEO (must match ambient). 2. Check 5V bias at 2-pin EGR temp sensor. 3. Replace open sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Catalyst Temp Sensor Bank 1 Sensor 1 Range — Skewed EGT
phContext: Euro-4/5 diesels; EGT1 reading 150°C off from EGT2 cold
symptoms: Aborted DPF regenerations, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare Ambient, ECT, EGT1, EGT2, and EGT3 cold KOEO (all must be within 5°C!). 2. Replace any outlier EGT sensor. 3. Reset DPF thermal model.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Exhaust Pressure Sensor Low — Broken Wire or Pinched Hose
phContext: Isuzu RZ4E/4JJ3, Toyota 2GD, Ford; EBP reads 0 kPa
symptoms: Limp mode, erratic turbo/EGR behavior
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Exhaust Pressure PID KOEO (must read ~101 kPa atmospheric). 2. Check 5V, GND, and signal at 3-pin EBP sensor. 3. Repair wire or replace sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Exhaust Pressure Sensor High — Soot-Blocked / Shorted to 5V
phContext: High-mileage Euro-4+ diesels; sensor reads >300 kPa at idle
symptoms: Immediate limp mode, DPF light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug EBP sensor; if PID drops to 0 kPa, sensor is shorted internally. 2. Clean carbon from metal tube leading to exhaust manifold. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF 5th Injector (Exhaust Fuel Injector) Fault (Toyota 1GD/2GD)
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/HiAce 1GD/2GD; soot-caked exhaust fuel injector
symptoms: DPF fails to reach 600°C during regen, P2463 follows
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove 5th fuel injector on exhaust downpipe and clean heavy carbon crust from tip. 2. Command 5th injector test via Techstream into beaker. 3. Check fuel supply valve.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Intake Manifold Runner Performance — Swirl Flap Motor Wear
phContext: Hyundai/Kia 2.2 CRDi (D4HB), Ford; stripped internal gear
symptoms: Sluggish acceleration, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Command VCM/Swirl actuator via scan tool and watch linkage travel. 2. Inspect plastic intake manifold for soot binding flaps. 3. Clean manifold and replace actuator.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Water in Fuel Sensor Circuit — Broken Wire Under Filter
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner, Ford Ranger, Isuzu; snapped wire during filter change
symptoms: WIF light stays on or never turns on during bulb check
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin connector at bottom of fuel filter/water separator (twisting filter without unplugging snaps wires!). 2. Repair twisted wires. 3. Drain separator.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF Differential Pressure Too Low — Gutted/Removed DPF
phContext: Used pickups where previous owner hollowed out DPF without ECU tune
symptoms: P244A/P2002, exhaust smells strongly of raw diesel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Diff Pressure PID at 3000 RPM (reads 0.0–0.2 kPa instead of 5– 15 kPa). 2. Tap DPF canister (hollow ring) or inspect tailpipe for black soot. 3. Check sensor hoses too.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF Differential Pressure Too High — Ash-Plugged DPF
phContext: High-mileage fleet diesels (>150,000 km) using non-low-SAPS oil
symptoms: Limp mode, forced static regen fails immediately
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Diff Pressure at idle (>5 kPa) and 2500 RPM (>25 kPa). 2. Non-burnable oil ash requires off-vehicle thermal/hydraulic DPF cleaning. 3. Use ACEA C2/C3 low-SAPS oil only!

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF Regeneration Duration — Failed to Complete (Thermostat/EGT)
phContext: Diesels with stuck-open thermostat (<75°C) preventing regen
symptoms: Regen starts and aborts every drive, oil dilution
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify ECT reaches >80°C! (ECU aborts regen if coolant is cool). 2. Check glow plugs (used as post-heat load during regen). 3. Fix thermostat/EGT before regen.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Vehicle Conditions Incorrect for DPF Regen — Active Faults
phContext: Any Euro-4+ diesel with active MAF/EGR/ECT code
symptoms: DPF fills up because ECU locks out passive/active regen
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ECM for ALL non-DPF codes first (any EGR/MAF/glow/EGT fault blocks regen!). 2. Fix primary sensor fault. 3. Perform service regen.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: ECM/PCM Power Input Signal Intermittent — Loose Battery Clamp
phContext: Pickups/vans after battery swap; loose terminal on diesel vibration
symptoms: Random stutter, stored P2509
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tighten battery terminals and inspect engine bay main relay. 2. Load-test batteries. 3. Clear code.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: MAF Sensor A/B Correlation — Split Air Filter Box / Hose
phContext: Dual-intake or MAF+MAP correlation diesels (Isuzu, Ford, Nissan)
symptoms: Limp mode, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check air filter housing clips (unclipped box leaks unmetered air!). 2. Smoke-test intake from airbox to turbo inlet. 3. Clean MAF and check boost hoses.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Diesel Intake Air Flow Control (Throttle Valve) Stuck
phContext: Toyota, Isuzu, Mitsubishi, Ford; soot-jammed intake shutter valve
symptoms: Engine shudders violently on key-off shutoff, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch intake throttle butterfly at key-off (must snap shut smoothly to stop diesel shudder). 2. Remove and clean heavy EGR soot ring around butterfly. 3. Check motor gears.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Diesel Intake Air Flow Position Sensor Low — Oil Inside Cap
phContext: Oil mist wicking down throttle shaft into electronics cap
symptoms: Limp mode, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug intake throttle valve and inspect for oil/coolant inside cap. 2. Check 5V/GND/signal. 3. Replace throttle actuator.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGR Throttle Control Range/Performance — Carbon Binding
phContext: Hyundai Starex/Tucson, Ford, Mitsubishi 4N15
symptoms: Rough shutoff, MIL on, DPF regen blocked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Actuate EGR throttle flap via scan tool (must sweep 0–100% smoothly). 2. Clean carbon from bore. 3. Check 12V fuse.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGT Sensor 1 Circuit High — Open Sensor / Broken Wire
phContext: Toyota 2GD, Ford Ranger, Isuzu; reads -40°C or 1000°C
symptoms: MIL on, regen disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug EGT1 and jump pins briefly; if PID flips from -40°C to +1000°C (or vice versa), harness/ECM is good and sensor is open. 2. Replace EGT1.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Glow Plug Control Module to PCM Comm Circuit
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest, Hyundai, Nissan; smart glow module fault
symptoms: Long cold cranking, glow light flashes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V IG1 and heavy B+ at glow control module. 2. Scope LIN/PWM wire between ECM and glow module. 3. Check individual glow plugs for shorts.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor / Pump Learn Error (Mitsubishi 4D56/4N15)
phContext: Mitsubishi Montero/Strada; after SCV or fuel filter replacement
symptoms: Surging idle, stalls at stoplight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform 'Small Injection Quantity Learning' / 'Fuel Pump Learning' via MUT-III / scan tool! 2. Ensure ECT >75°C and A/C off during learn. 3. Verify idle stability.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Battery Voltage / EDU / Injector Coding Error
phContext: Isuzu 4JJ1/4JK1, Toyota; lost injector trim memory
symptoms: Clattering idle, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read stored injector IDs in ECM and compare with physical injector tops. 2. Re-write exact IDs. 3. Check ECM keep-alive fuse.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Fuel Injector Group A Supply Low — Harness Chafed on Valve Cover
phContext: Ford Ranger, Hyundai, Mitsubishi; wire rubbing metal bracket
symptoms: Engine stalls dead, Bank/Group A dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug injectors in Group A and ohm-test harness wires to ground. 2. Inspect valve cover harness loom for rub-through. 3. Repair wire.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Injector Control Pressure Too Low — Cranking (Air in Fuel)
phContext: Diesels after dry fuel tank or fuel filter replacement without bleeding
symptoms: Cranks 10+ seconds, won't fire, P2291
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hand-prime fuel filter housing until firm (or run in-tank lift pump 3x KOEO). 2. Check filter O-ring for air suction leak. 3. Monitor rail pressure during crank (>20 MPa needed).

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Intercooler Oil Accumulation — Excessive PCV Blow-by
phContext: High-mileage Hilux, Montero, HiAce; worn piston rings or clogged PCV
symptoms: Thick oily sludge dripping from intercooler hose joints
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check PCV baffle/diaphragm in valve cover. 2. Measure crankcase blow-by pressure. 3. Drain intercooler of oil (prevents diesel runaway!) and install catch can if needed.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Diesel Fuel Gel / Algae Growth (Biodiesel CME Microbial)
phContext: PH CME-blended diesel sitting in tank/drum during humid months
symptoms: Black slime clogging fuel filter every 1,000 km
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect old fuel filter element for dark slimy biofilm. 2. Drain tank, clean pickup sock, and treat with diesel biocide. 3. Replace fuel filter.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Fuel Pressure Regulator 1 Control Circuit — Open SCV
phContext: Toyota D-4D, Nissan YD25, Mitsubishi; broken SCV wire near pump
symptoms: Cranks no start or max-pressure diesel knock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure SCV coil resistance (typically 1.9–2.5 ohms at 20°C). 2. Check 12V feed at SCV plug. 3. Repair wire near high-pressure pump.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Fuel Temp Sensor Range/Performance — Skewed NTC
phContext: Common rail diesels; fuel temp reads 120°C cold
symptoms: Slight power loss (ECM derates fuel density)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare Fuel Temp PID vs. Ambient/ECT cold KOEO. 2. Measure sensor resistance. 3. Replace fuel temp sensor on HP pump/rail.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Turbo Boost Sensor A Range — Clogged Sensor Nipple
phContext: Diesel pickups/SUVs; soot + oil blocking tiny MAP sensor hole
symptoms: Sluggish boost response, limp mode on highway
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare MAP PID vs. Baro PID at KOEO (must match within 2 kPa). 2. Clean sensor port gently (do not poke diaphragm!). 3. Check boost hose.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGR Control Circuit — Broken Stepper Coil / Brush
phContext: Toyota, Isuzu, Nissan; internal EGR motor open
symptoms: MIL on, EGR stuck closed or partially open
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure EGR motor/stepper coil resistances at connector. 2. Check 12V relay feed. 3. Replace EGR valve assembly.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGR Throttle Position Control — Stripped Plastic Gears
phContext: Mitsubishi 4N15, Ford, Hyundai; buzzing noise from intake throttle
symptoms: MIL on, rough engine shutoff
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove plastic gear cover on intake throttle body to inspect stripped teeth. 2. Clean carbon from butterfly. 3. Replace intake throttle body.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Starter Request Circuit — Ignition Switch / Relay Feedback
phContext: Ford, Isuzu, Toyota; ECM detects starter engage discrepancy
symptoms: Intermittent no-crank or starter timeout
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor Starter Request PID during crank. 2. Check starter relay and clutch/park safety switch. 3. Inspect starter S-terminal wire.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Fuel Injector Control Module (FICM/EDU) Performance
phContext: Ford, Isuzu, Toyota; low battery voltage dropping EDU boost
symptoms: Hard cold start, rough idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test batteries (EDU needs >10.5V during crank to generate 80– 110V). 2. Inspect EDU capacitors and grounds. 3. Replace weak battery/EDU.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: MAF Sensor Intermittent (Ford/Nissan) — Loose Connector Pin
phContext: Ford Ranger, Nissan Navara; spread female pins in MAF plug
symptoms: Sudden bucking over bumps, black smoke puff
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform pin-drag test on MAF connector terminals. 2. Wiggle harness while watching MAF g/s PID at idle. 3. Re-pin connector.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGR Valve Position Sensor / Flow Blocked (Mitsubishi)
phContext: Mitsubishi Montero/Strada 4D56/4N15; soot-jammed valve
symptoms: MIL on, sluggish acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove EGR valve and clean pintle/seat. 2. Perform EGR valve learn/reset if supported. 3. Check EGR cooler passage.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: EGT Sensor 1 Range/Performance — Slow Thermal Response
phContext: Euro-4/5 diesels; fouled EGT probe tip
symptoms: Failed DPF regen, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Graph EGT1 vs. EGT2 during cold-to-warm idle. 2. Replace sluggish EGT sensor. 3. Check exhaust leaks.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor D Circuit — Water/Wear
phContext: Diesel pickups with wet muddy boots
symptoms: Limp mode at 1200 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check APP1 and APP2 voltage sweeps. 2. Dry pedal connector. 3. Replace pedal assembly.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Barometric Pressure Sensor Range — Altitude / Internal ECM
phContext: Diesels climbing Baguio/Atok (>1500m) with clogged ECM vent
symptoms: Limp mode at high altitude, black smoke
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare Baro PID (~101 kPa sea level, ~85 kPa Baguio) vs. MAP at KOEO. 2. Note: Baro sensor is usually inside ECM! 3. Inspect ECM case vent membrane for mud/tape.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Turbo Boost Not Detected Mechanical — Seized Turbo Shaft
phContext: High-mileage diesels starved of oil (clogged turbo oil feed line)
symptoms: Zero boost, loud screech or silence from turbo, heavy smoke
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove intake boot and spin compressor wheel by fingers (must spin freely with minimal play). 2. If seized, inspect turbo oil feed banjo bolt screen! 3. Replace turbo & feed line.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF Differential Pressure Sensor A Circuit — Wet Sensor
phContext: Sensor mounted near cowl/firewall exposed to windshield cowl overflow
symptoms: Immediate DPF light, diff pressure stuck at max/min
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 3-pin DPF diff pressure sensor for water inside connector. 2. Check 5V, GND, and signal (~0.5–1.0V KOEO). 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: DPF Differential Pressure Sensor Low — Shorted Ground/Wire
phContext: Pinched harness behind engine block
symptoms: DPF light on, diff pressure reads -5 kPa or 0V
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure signal wire voltage unplugged (5V bias check). 2. Trace wire for short to ground. 3. Replace shorted sensor.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Charging System Voltage — Alternator Belt/Regulator
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest, Hyundai; weak alternator under glow load
symptoms: Battery light on, glow plugs disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check charging voltage (13.8– 14.5V). 2. Inspect serpentine belt & OAP pulley. 3. Check LIN alternator control wire.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Timing Belt / Chain Jump (1 Tooth) — Hard Start & Smoke
phContext: Mitsubishi 4D56 (belt) / Nissan YD25 (chain); skipped tooth
symptoms: Cranks long, white/gray smoke, zero low-end power, loud rattle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check mechanical timing marks (cam, crank, HP pump) at TDC! 2. Inspect tensioner failure or broken balance-shaft belt tangling timing belt (classic 4D56!). 3. Replace belt/chain kit.

domainName: Common Rail Diesel Euro-4/5/6, AdBlue/SCR & Piezo Injectors
title: Cracked Piston / Low Compression on Cylinder #1/#4
phContext: Tuned/remapped diesel pickups over-fueled on steep climbs
symptoms: Heavy white smoke, rhythmic chuffing from oil filler cap
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform relative compression test on oscilloscope (one low current hump). 2. Pull glow plug and run compression test (spec >2400 kPa). 3. Inspect injector over-fueling cause.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Millimeter-Wave Radar Blocked — Heavy Rain / Mud
phContext: Toyota Fortuner/Corolla Cross, Honda City/Civic, BYD
symptoms: 'Pre-Collision System Unavailable' during heavy downpour or mud
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front grille emblem/radar cover for mud, heavy insect crust, or aftermarket metallic grille! 2. Wipe clean and test in clear weather. 3. Check if bracket bent.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Radar Misaligned — Minor Traffic Bumper Tap
phContext: Cars bumped lightly in Metro Manila parking or traffic
symptoms: ACC/AEB warning on dash, radar angle out of spec
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect radar mounting bracket behind front bumper/emblem for bent tabs. 2. Read Radar Horizontal/Vertical Misalignment Angle PIDs. 3. Straighten bracket and run static/dynamic ADAS calibration.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Lost Comm with Front Radar Sensor — Unplugged After Bodywork
phContext: Vehicles returning from collision/repaint shop
symptoms: ADAS/ACC warning solid on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove upper radiator cover and inspect radar connector behind front emblem. 2. Check 12V IG1, ground, and CAN-H/L at radar plug. 3. Clear codes and calibrate.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Forward Recognition Camera Blocked — Dark Tint / Condensation
phContext: Cars with dark metallic/ceramic tint installed over camera triangle!
symptoms: Lane Keep Assist / Auto High-Beam unavailable, camera error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect windshield camera cutout for window tint overlapping lens, fogging, or dirty glass inside housing! 2. Clean glass and cut tint clear of camera view. 3. Run camera aim calibration.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Forward Camera Over-Temperature — Parked Under PH Noon Sun
phContext: Windshield-mounted ADAS cameras in 40°C+ parked cars
symptoms: ADAS disabled temporarily on hot afternoon startup, clears after A/C cools cabin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Forward Camera Internal Temp PID (shuts off above ~85°C to protect CMOS sensor). 2. Verify defroster/cabin cooling clears fault. 3. Advise sunshade use.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Forward Camera Calibration Incomplete — Windshield Replaced
phContext: Vehicles after aftermarket windshield replacement without ADAS aim
symptoms: LKAS/PCS lights flashing, 'Camera Calibration Needed'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify OEM-spec acoustic/ADAS windshield glass was used (cheap wavy glass distorts camera!). 2. Set up OEM target board on level floor and run static/dynamic camera calibration.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Blind Spot Monitor (BSM) Left/Right Blocked — Rear Bumper Mud/Foil
phContext: SUVs/crossovers (Fortuner, Montero, Territory, BYD); bumper corner
symptoms: 'BSM Unavailable', false blind-spot alerts in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inside corners of rear bumper for caked mud, metallic bumper stickers, or aftermarket metal brackets! 2. Verify BSM radar angle (often 45°). 3. Clean & test.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Lost Comm with Side Obstacle Detection (BSM) — Rear Splash
phContext: Vehicles crossing deep puddles; rear bumper corner radar connector
symptoms: BSM warning on dash, mirror indicators dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reach behind rear bumper corner and unplug BSM module to check for water/green pins. 2. Check 12V IG1 and Private-CAN wires between Left & Right BSM slaves. 3. Replace corroded module.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: TPMS Tire Pressure Sensor 1 No Signal — Broken by Tire Shop
phContext: SUVs/crossovers with direct TPMS; tire machine snapped valve stem
symptoms: TPMS light flashes 60 sec then solid, one tire reads '--'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan all 4 wheels with TPMS LF trigger tool (315/433 MHz) to find dead sensor. 2. Replace snapped sensor/valve stem and program new sensor ID into TPMS/BCM ECU. 3. Test drive.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: TPMS Low Pressure Warning in Baguio / Cold Morning
phContext: Cars inflated in hot Manila (32 psi) driven up to cold Baguio (27 psi)
symptoms: TPMS light turns on in morning, disappears by noon
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure all 4 tires (including spare tire if monitored!) with calibrated gauge cold. 2. Inflate to door-jamb placard spec +2 psi buffer. 3. Reset indirect TPMS if equipped.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: TPMS Sensor Battery Low — 6–8 Year Old Lithium Cell
phContext: 2018–2020 SUVs/sedans with factory direct TPMS sensors
symptoms: Intermittent TPMS light, sensor drops out at highway speed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read TPMS Sensor Battery Status PIDs with LF diagnostic tool. 2. Replace aging sealed TPMS sensor (batteries are non-replaceable). 3. Relearn IDs.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Wrong Tire Position Shown on TPMS After Tire Rotation
phContext: Vehicles after 10,000 km tire rotation without TPMS relearn
symptoms: Front-left warning lights up when rear-right tire is actually flat!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Trigger each tire in OEM sequence (FL -> FR -> RR -> RL) using TPMS relearn mode. 2. Verify screen updates to match physical tire positions.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Parking Sonar Sensor Front/Rear Open — Bumper Paint / Impact
phContext: SUVs/MPVs with factory 4/8-sensor sonar; thick repaint over sensor
symptoms: Continuous beep in Reverse/Drive, 'Check Sonar System'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen/touch each sensor with ignition ON & Reverse engaged (working sensors click/vibrate). 2. Check if body shop painted thickly over ultrasonic sensor ring! 3. Replace dead sensor.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Parking Sensors Beep Randomly in Rain — Water Droplet
phContext: Front bumper sonar sensors during heavy monsoon downpour
symptoms: False obstacle beeps at stoplights in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect sensor rubber isolation ring for damage. 2. Check if aftermarket license plate frame edges intrude into sensor cone. 3. Dry and test.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: 360-Degree Around-View Camera Distorted — Unfolded Mirror
phContext: SUVs/EVs (Territory, Montero, BYD, Navara); side mirror bumped
symptoms: 360 top-down view looks warped or one side black
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ensure both side mirrors are fully deployed/locked! 2. Inspect under-mirror camera connector inside door if black. 3. Run 360-camera mat stitching calibration if mirror replaced.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Radar Voltage Out of Range — Loose Ground / Alternator
phContext: Cars with weak 12V battery or corroded front radiator support ground
symptoms: ACC drops out when A/C fan kicks on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V at radar connector under load. 2. Clean front chassis ground lug. 3. Test battery/alternator.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: ADAS Disabled Due to Engine/ABS Fault — Secondary Lockout
phContext: Any ADAS car with active Check Engine or ABS light
symptoms: ACC, AEB, and LKAS all disable simultaneously when MIL turns on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Do NOT calibrate ADAS! Scan Engine ECM and ABS first. 2. Fix primary engine/wheel-speed fault. 3. Clear codes; ADAS will self-restore.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Adaptive Cruise Control Switch Stuck — Spilled Drink on Wheel
phContext: Steering wheel ACC buttons sticky or unresponsive
symptoms: ACC refuses to turn on, C1A45 stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor ACC button resistance/PIDs while pressing. 2. Clean sticky switch bezel. 3. Check clock spring continuity.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Auto Emergency Braking (AEB) False Trigger — Steel Road Plates
phContext: Vehicles driving over raised steel trench plates in Metro Manila roadwork
symptoms: Sudden brief brake jolt / beep over metal plates or steep ramp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain millimeter-wave radar reflection physics on metal plates/steep dips. 2. Verify radar vertical alignment angle is within +/-1.0° spec. 3. Check for OEM radar software TSB.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA) Fault — Bumper Fascia Dent
phContext: Cars backed into post; dented plastic bumper warping radar beam
symptoms: False RCTA warnings or RCTA disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove rear bumper fascia and inspect underlying BSM/RCTA radar bracket for bends. 2. Ensure no metal foil/repair tape was placed over inside of bumper! 3. Realign & calibrate.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Steering Angle Sensor Out of Sync with Forward Camera
phContext: Cars after tie-rod/alignment without SAS zero-point reset
symptoms: Lane Keep Assist pulls car toward lane line
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify mechanical wheel alignment and centered steering wheel. 2. Reset SAS zero-point in ABS/EPS. 3. Run Forward Camera dynamic road calibration.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: TPMS Interference from Cheap 12V USB Charger / Dashcam
phContext: Cars with noisy buck-converter 12V chargers jamming 315/433 MHz RF
symptoms: TPMS light turns on only when phone charger/dashcam is plugged in!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug all aftermarket 12V chargers/dashcams and test drive 15 min! 2. If TPMS recovers, replace noisy charger with shielded OEM-grade adapter.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Forward Camera Heater Circuit Open — Fogged Lens in Rain
phContext: Vehicles with heated windshield camera pod; broken flex cable
symptoms: Camera fogs up on rainy nights, LKAS unavailable
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect camera bracket heater element resistance. 2. Check for cracked windshield seal letting humid air into pod. 3. Clean lens and replace heater pad.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Parking Assist Control Module Internal Fault — Trunk Moisture
phContext: Sedans/SUVs with sonar ECU mounted in rear quarter/trunk well
symptoms: All parking sensors dead, continuous error tone
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect trunk side pocket for water leak from taillight gasket. 2. Check sonar ECU connector for green corrosion. 3. Dry/replace module.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Driver Monitoring Camera (DMS) False Drowsiness Alert
phContext: Modern Chinese/Japanese SUVs with IR steering-column/A-pillar camera
symptoms: Constant 'Driver Distracted / Take a Break' beeps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if polarized sunglasses or steering wheel cover block IR camera! 2. Clean IR lens gently. 3. Adjust wheel height or disable sensitivity in settings.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Radar Vertical Misalignment — Heavy Rear Cargo / Lift
phContext: Pickups/SUVs with 2-inch suspension lift or heavy rear load
symptoms: ACC loses target cars ahead or triggers false AEB
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: 2-inch lift kits change radar pitch angle! 2. Adjust radar aiming screws per OEM target height or install leveling bracket. 3. Run radar calibration.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Indirect TPMS False Alarm After New Tire Install
phContext: Honda/VW/Mazda using ABS wheel speed circumference instead of sensors
symptoms: TPMS light turns on 20 min after buying 2 new tires
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify all 4 tire pressures match placard. 2. Press and hold TPMS Calibration button (or reset in infotainment) so ABS learns new tire rolling radius!

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Center-Left Rear Sonar Sensor Short — Tow Hitch / Bike Rack
phContext: SUVs with aftermarket tow bar or step-board blocking sensor
symptoms: Continuous beep when shifting to Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if sensor is detecting newly installed tow hitch/step bar! 2. Press P-OFF button when towing, or inspect sensor face for paint chips/water. 3. Replace faulty sensor.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Lost Comm with Ride Height / Headlamp Leveling Module
phContext: SUVs with auto-leveling LED headlights; broken rear axle link
symptoms: Headlight leveling warning on dash, beams point at ground
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect small plastic/metal linkage arm on rear suspension control arm (snaps on lubak!). 2. Check 3-pin height sensor 5V/GND/signal. 3. Replace link and zero headlights.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Auto High-Beam (AHB) Fails to Dim — Dirty Windshield / Tint
phContext: Cars blinding oncoming drivers on provincial highways
symptoms: High beams stay on despite oncoming headlights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean windshield directly in front of camera pod. 2. Check if dark tint reduces light sensitivity. 3. Verify camera aim.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Brake Actuator / AEB Pressure Hold Fault — ABS Valve
phContext: ADAS cars where AEB triggers warning due to ABS hydraulic fault
symptoms: Pre-Collision System off, ABS light may or may not be on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS/VSC module for pressure sensor or brake switch codes. 2. Bleed brake fluid if air trapped. 3. Clear both ABS and ADAS codes.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: 360 Camera Blue/Black Screen on One Side — Door Hinge Wire
phContext: Cars with side-mirror cameras; broken coax/LVDS wire in door boot
symptoms: Left or right camera view black, front/rear work
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flex driver/passenger door rubber bellows while watching 360 screen. 2. Inspect mirror-to-door connector for water corrosion. 3. Repair camera harness.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Front Corner Sonar Sensor Open — Lower Valance Snag
phContext: Sedans scraping steep PH driveway ramps
symptoms: Front parking sensor error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reach behind front bumper corner and check if sensor plug popped loose from curb scrape. 2. Test sensor resistance/voltage. 3. Reclip and test.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Intelligent Speed Assist / Traffic Sign Recognition Wrong
phContext: Cars reading '40' truck speed stickers or faded PH road signs
symptoms: Dash flashes wrong speed limit constantly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain camera OCR limitations on PH signage. 2. Check infotainment map/camera region settings. 3. Adjust speed alert tolerance.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Radar Internal Hardware Error — Water Inside Sealed Unit
phContext: Cracked plastic radar housing after stone hit on expressway
symptoms: Permanent radar fault, cannot calibrate
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front face of radar unit for hairline stone crack. 2. Verify 12V/GND/CAN are good at plug. 3. Replace radar unit and calibrate.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Lost Comm with Right BSM Module — Damaged Rear Harness
phContext: Pickups/SUVs after rear bumper replacement
symptoms: BSM fault on dash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rear bumper sub-harness plug near chassis rail (often left unplugged after bumper install!). 2. Verify 12V/GND and Private-CAN. 3. Reconnect.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: TPMS Receiver / ECU Antenna Fault — Rear Glass / Roof
phContext: SUVs with TPMS RF receiver near rear quarter/headliner
symptoms: All 4 tires show '--' simultaneously!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if ALL 4 sensors stopped reporting at once (points to TPMS ECU/receiver, not 4 dead sensors!). 2. Check TPMS ECU 12V fuse and CAN lines. 3. Test with LF tool.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Cross-Traffic Braking Slams Brakes Reversing Out of Driveway
phContext: Modern SUVs with RCTB (Rear Cross Traffic Auto-Brake) on tight streets
symptoms: Sudden violent brake slam when bushes/pedestrians pass behind
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify rear bumper sensors are clean and properly aimed. 2. Explain RCTB sensitivity in tight PH streets (can be toggled in settings if needed). 3. Check ABS/BSM codes.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: Forward Camera Voltage Out of Range — Shared Dome Fuse
phContext: Cars with dashcam tapped into overhead dome/mirror fuse improperly
symptoms: Camera drops out when interior lights/sunroof operate
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove aftermarket dashcam fuse-tap from ADAS/Camera circuit! 2. Rewire dashcam to dedicated ACC/B+ slot. 3. Clear camera DTC.

domainName: ADAS, Radar, Forward Camera, TPMS & Parking Assist Systems
title: ADAS Dynamic Calibration Fails to Complete in Traffic
phContext: Technicians attempting dynamic road calibration in slow EDSA traffic
symptoms: Scan tool stuck at 10% calibration progress
diagnosticSteps: 1. Dynamic camera calibration requires steady >40–60 km/h with clear painted lane lines (expressways like SLEX/NLEX/CALAX). 2. Avoid rainy/dark conditions. 3. Complete drive cycle.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Touchscreen Ghost-Touching / Delaminating — PH Cabin Heat
phContext: Mazda, Honda, Toyota, Ford, Geely parked outdoors in tropical sun
symptoms: Screen changes radio stations or dials calls by itself
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect digitizer glass for bubbling/spiderwebbing around edges (heat-melted optical adhesive). 2. Disconnect digitizer ribbon or replace touchscreen digitizer. 3. Advise windshield sunshade.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Apple CarPlay / Android Auto Disconnects Over Bumps
phContext: All modern PH cars; loose USB-A/C port or cheap charging-only cable
symptoms: Projection drops out randomly on rough roads
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test with short (<1m) certified USB data cable first. 2. Inspect dashboard USB hub pins for lint/spread contacts. 3. Update head unit firmware or replace USB hub module.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Instrument Cluster LCD Fading / Dead Pixels When Hot
phContext: Older 2010–2018 sedans/pickups; heat-aged LCD zebra strip
symptoms: Odometer/gear display illegible at noon, readable at night
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect cluster LCD ribbon cable / elastomeric zebra strip. 2. Reflow LCD driver pins or replace LCD glass panel. 3. Check 5V regulator on cluster PCB.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: No Sound from Speakers, Head Unit Powers On — Shorted Speaker
phContext: Cars after rain/door flood; rusted door speaker coil shorting to door metal
symptoms: Radio turns on, volume bar moves, zero audio from all 4 speakers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug speaker harness at rear of head unit and measure each speaker pair (spec 3.5–4.5 ohms, INFINITE ohms to chassis ground!). 2. Disconnect shorted door speaker (protects amp IC). 3. Replace speaker.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Steering Wheel Volume/Mode Buttons Trigger Wrong Functions
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Hyundai ; resistive ladder switch or clock spring
symptoms: Pressing Volume+ changes track or mutes audio
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure resistance across steering switch wire at clock spring output while pressing each button (each button has a distinct resistor value). 2. Clean switch PCB or replace clock spring.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Speedometer Reads 20 km/h Too Fast or Zero — Needle Stepper
phContext: Older analog-needle clusters; stripped stepper motor or wrong tire size
symptoms: Needle sticks at 0 or jumps erratically
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run Instrument Cluster Actuator/Gauge Sweep Test via scan tool (if needle stutters while VSS PID is smooth, cluster stepper motor is bad!). 2. Replace X27/Switec stepper motor.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Odometer / Trip Meter Resets Every Key-Off — Blown Backup Fuse
phContext: Cars after audio/dashcam install; blown DOME / BACKUP 10A fuse
symptoms: Clock resets to 1:00, trip A/B resets, radio presets lost every morning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DOME / BACKUP / ROOM 7.5A–15A fuse in engine bay fuse box. 2. Verify constant 12V (KL30) at cluster rear pin with key off. 3. Trace short in dome light or aftermarket radio.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Bluetooth Hands-Free Mic Dead — Unplugged Overhead Console
phContext: Cars after windshield tinting or dashcam hardwiring down A-pillar
symptoms: Caller cannot hear driver, driver hears caller fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check head unit mic input settings and test voice memo. 2. Drop overhead map-light console to check if 2/3-pin mic plug was left disconnected during tint/dashcam install! 3. Test mic bias voltage.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Wireless Phone Charger Overheats & Stops — Metal Coin/Case
phContext: Fortuner, Montero, Territory, BYD, City RS; FOD (Foreign Object Detection)
symptoms: Wireless pad blinks amber/red and stops charging
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove thick MagSafe/metal-ring phone cases and check rubber mat for coins/keys! 2. Check wireless charger cooling fan/vent under console. 3. Check 12V IGN feed.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Telematics / e-Call SOS Module Battery Fault — Dead Backup Cell
phContext: Modern connected SUVs (Ford, Toyota, Geely, MG, BYD)
symptoms: 'SOS Call System Malfunction' warning on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan Telematics Control Unit (TCU) for backup battery voltage DTC. 2. Locate TCU (behind glovebox/under seat) and replace internal 3.6V/7.2V lithium backup battery. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Head Unit Stuck in Boot Loop / Frozen Logo — Corrupted Flash
phContext: Factory & Android infotainment units after weak battery cranking
symptoms: Logo spins endlessly, rear camera dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform hard reboot (hold Power+Seek or pull Radio/ACC fuse 5 min). 2. Flash OEM USB firmware update if supported. 3. Check eMMC flash chip failure.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Fuel Gauge Stuck Full Forever — Shorted/Open Sender Wire
phContext: Sedans/pickups; broken wire on top of fuel tank (rat bite!)
symptoms: Needle stays above F or drops to E permanently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Fuel Level Resistance/Voltage PID in cluster/BCM. 2. Unplug fuel pump hat under rear seat; watch gauge/PID (open vs. jumped = confirms gauge works!). 3. Fix tank harness or float.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Coolant Temp Gauge Stuck Cold or Spikes — Cluster vs. ECM
phContext: Cars with separate 1-pin gauge sender vs. 2-pin ECM ECT sensor
symptoms: Dash temp gauge dead while radiator fan works normally
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read ECT PID via scan tool (if PID reads 88°C normally, engine sensor is fine). 2. Inspect 1-pin gauge sender or cluster CAN/stepper motor. 3. Bleed cooling air pocket.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Factory Subwoofer / Amp No Output — Blown Trunk Amp Fuse
phContext: Top-trim SUVs/sedans (Fortuner LTD, Civic RS, Territory, BYD)
symptoms: Door speakers play tinny highs only, no bass
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check external AMP 25A/30A fuse. 2. Inspect under-seat or trunk-side amplifier for floodwater stains. 3. Check remote turn-on 12V / MOST / A2B bus.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Dashcam Corrupting SD Card / Not Recording — Heat & Capacitor
phContext: PH parked cars; lithium-battery dashcams swelling in 60°C heat
symptoms: Dashcam beeps 'SD Error' or shuts off instantly at key-off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace swollen lithium-ion dashcam with supercapacitor model. 2. Use High-Endurance U3 microSD card (standard cards fail in months). 3. Check hardwire kit voltage cutoff (11.8V–12.0V).

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Alternator Whine Through Speakers — Ground Loop
phContext: Cars with aftermarket amplifier or AUX/Android unit
symptoms: High-pitched whine rising with engine RPM through tweeters
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ensure amplifier ground is bolted to bare chassis metal <0.5m long (never seat-bolt paint!). 2. Route RCA audio cables away from main 12V power wire. 3. Check alternator diode ripple.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Warning Chime / Buzzer Silent — Dead Cluster Piezo Speaker
phContext: Cars where turn signal click and seatbelt chime disappear completely
symptoms: Indicators flash visually on dash with zero clicking sound
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run Cluster Speaker/Chime Test via scan tool. 2. Disassemble cluster and test tiny 8/16-ohm speaker on rear PCB (heat/humidity cracks voice coil). 3. Solder replacement speaker.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Android Head Unit Can't Read Reverse Gear — Missing Back-Up Wire
phContext: Aftermarket head unit on manual/older AT cars
symptoms: Reverse camera works only if manually opened, doesn't auto-switch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V on head unit 'BACK / REVERSE' trigger wire when shifting to R. 2. Tap clean 12V reverse lamp signal (or verify CANbus decoder box outputs 12V in R). 3. Test.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Digital Clock / Radio Won't Dim at Night — Missing ILL Wire
phContext: Aftermarket stereo blinding driver at night
symptoms: Screen stays at 100% daytime brightness with headlights on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check orange 'ILL / DIMMER' wire on radio harness (must receive 12V when park lights turn on). 2. Verify cluster dimmer rheostat isn't turned to Max. 3. Connect ILL wire.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Power Outlet / Inverter 220V Dead (Pickups/MPVs)
phContext: Hilux/Fortuner/Innova/Ran ger with factory 100W/150W 220V AC socket
symptoms: Laptop/charger won't power from rear console AC outlet
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check INV 15A/20A fuse and if outlet is enabled via dash switch (some require engine running/Park). 2. Ensure load is <100W–150W (overloads trip thermal cutoff). 3. Test inverter unit.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Rear Entertainment Screen Dead — Broken Seatback Hinge Wire
phContext: MPVs/SUVs with headrest/roof-mounted monitors
symptoms: Screen flickers when tilting seat or stays black
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A/15A RSE fuse. 2. Inspect braided harness inside seatback hinge or roof-liner pivot for snapped power/video wire. 3. Repair with flexible wire.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Head-Up Display (HUD) Dim or Misaligned — Replaced Windshield
phContext: Mazda/BMW/BYD/Toyota with windshield HUD
symptoms: Double blurry image projected on glass
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify OEM HUD-grade acoustic windshield was installed (non-HUD glass lacks wedge interlayer, causing double reflection!). 2. Check HUD brightness/height settings.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: AM/FM Radio Static When Rear Defogger On — Broken Grid/Filter
phContext: Sedans/hatchbacks with in-glass FM antenna
symptoms: Clear FM radio turns to loud static the moment rear defogger turns on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear glass antenna amplifier (C-pillar) ground and 12V feed. 2. Check for broken defogger grid line arcing RF noise. 3. Check noise suppressor capacitor.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: TPMS / Door Open Graphic Shows Wrong Side — RHD/LHD Coding
phContext: Used/gray-market or flashed clusters coded for Right-Hand Drive
symptoms: Opening driver (left) door shows passenger (right) door open on screen
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check cluster/BCM EEPROM or variant coding for LHD (Left-Hand Drive) vs. RHD. 2. Re-code to Philippines LHD spec. 3. Verify.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Oil Change / Maintenance Reminder Light Won't Clear
phContext: Toyota, Honda, Mitsubishi, Ford, Isuzu after PMS
symptoms: 'Maintenance Required' or wrench icon stays on after oil change
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform OEM cluster/infotainment maintenance reset procedure (e.g., Trip A + ODO hold at key-on, or scan tool Service Reset). 2. Verify interval set to 5,000/10,000 km.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Lost Comm with Parking Assist / Sonar Module — Cluster Flag
phContext: Cars with aftermarket head unit removing factory sonar interface
symptoms: Cluster displays 'Check Parking System' continuously
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check sonar module fuse and CAN lines. 2. Verify CANbus adapter box supports factory sonar display if stock radio removed. 3. Reconnect unplugged bumper harness.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Glovebox / Center Console Light Stuck ON — Missing Bump Stop
phContext: Cars with plunger switch on glovebox door
symptoms: Battery drains slowly over weekend
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if rubber bump stop on glovebox door fell off so switch isn't depressed when closed. 2. Stick felt/rubber pad on door contact point. 3. Verify light turns off.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: USB-C Fast Charge Port Drops to 5V Slow — Thermal Throttling
phContext: Modern SUVs/EVs charging phones in hot cabin
symptoms: Phone charges very slowly or disconnects
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure USB-C PD output with inline USB tester. 2. Check for bent pins or pocket lint packed inside USB-C port. 3. Replace rear console USB module.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Compass / Navigation Stuck — Unplugged GPS Shark-Fin Antenna
phContext: Cars after roof-wrap or headliner removal
symptoms: Factory map shows car in the ocean or wrong street
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect blue Fakra GPS connector behind head unit and above rear headliner (shark-fin base). 2. Check for water leak inside shark-fin antenna. 3. Replace antenna.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Aftermarket Horn Relay Chattering — Weak Switch Ground
phContext: Dual-tone Bosch/Hella snail horns wired without proper relay
symptoms: Horns sound weak/croaking, fuse blows
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wire horns with dedicated 30A relay directly from battery (+) via 20A fuse, using factory horn wire only to trigger relay coil! 2. Clean horn bracket ground.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Cluster Backlight Flickers — Failing Dimmer Rheostat
phContext: Older Toyota/Mitsubishi/Nissan with rotary dash dimmer
symptoms: Dash lights strobe or go black until knob is tapped
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rotate dimmer rheostat back and forth rapidly (if lights flicker, carbon track is dirty). 2. Spray contact cleaner or replace dimmer switch. 3. Check tail fuse.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: CarPlay Audio Plays Only on Front Tweeters — Nav Prompt Stuck
phContext: Head unit stuck in 'Navigation Guidance' audio channel
symptoms: Music sounds muffled/mono on driver speaker only
diagnosticSteps: 1. Trigger voice assistant (Siri/Google) and cancel it cleanly to release audio focus! 2. Reboot head unit. 3. Update head unit software.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Device Power #1 Circuit Voltage Below Threshold — Cluster Brownout
phContext: GM/Chevrolet/Suzuki/Hyu ndai; weak battery dropping cluster <9V
symptoms: Cluster resets during crank, stores B1325
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test battery and clean terminals. 2. Check cluster B+ and IG1 pin voltage drop. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Ambient Temperature Display Frozen at 25°C — Logic Filter
phContext: Cars where display only updates above 30 km/h
symptoms: Outside temp reads morning cool temp all afternoon in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain OEM logic (locks temp update below 20–30 km/h to prevent radiator heat soak false readings!). 2. Drive >35 km/h for 3 min to verify normal update. 3. Check sensor if still stuck.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Keyless Entry Buzzer Outside Car Dead — Front Piezo Beeper
phContext: Push-start cars (Vios, Xpander, City); missing beep when locking
symptoms: Hazards blink on lock, no chirp sound
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate small waterproof lock-answerback buzzer behind front fender/rad support. 2. Test with 12V/PWM (often filled with flood mud). 3. Replace buzzer.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Rear View Mirror Auto-Dimming Stuck Dark — Broken Sensor
phContext: Top-trim SUVs/sedans; electrochromic fluid leaked or rear sensor blocked
symptoms: Mirror stays pitch-black in daytime
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if dashcam or sticker blocks the forward-facing light sensor on back of mirror! 2. Inspect glass for dark brown/amber fluid leak (cracked electrochromic cell). 3. Replace mirror.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Seatbelt Reminder Chimes with Empty Passenger Seat — Laptop/Bag
phContext: Heavy work bag or groceries placed on front passenger seat
symptoms: Chime sounds continuously while driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove heavy items (>2–3 kg) from front passenger seat (capacitive/weight mat detects them as occupant!). 2. Check if wet seat cushion triggers capacitive mat. 3. Dry seat.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Digital Tachometer / Speedo Lags — Slow CAN Refresh / Fault
phContext: Aftermarket OBD-II HUD or gauge plugged into DLC port
symptoms: Cluster stutters or lags when OBD gauge is plugged in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug cheap OBD-II HUD/display causing CAN bus frame collisions! 2. Test cluster response alone. 3. Use passive read-only display if needed.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Power Folding Mirror Unfolds Too Far (180° Forward) — Stop Pin
phContext: Cars hit by passing motorcycle in traffic; broken internal stop
symptoms: Mirror swings all the way forward against front fender
diagnosticSteps: 1. Cycle fold switch while gently holding mirror at normal position to re-index clutch. 2. Disassemble mirror base to inspect sheared metal stop pin. 3. Replace mirror hinge.

domainName: Infotainment, Telematics, Cluster, Gauges & Cabin Electronics
title: Cigarette Lighter / 12V Socket Loose — Bent Ground Tabs
phContext: High-use TNVS/delivery vehicles; phone chargers pop out
symptoms: Charger cuts in and out over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull 15A ACC fuse FIRST! 2. Bend inner side-ground spring tabs slightly inward, or replace worn socket barrel. 3. Reinstall fuse and test.

domainName: Electronic Suspension, AWD/4WD Couplings, Diff Locks & Chassis
title: 4WD Transfer Case Shift Actuator Timeout — Seized Motor
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner, Ford Ranger, Navara; unused 4WD for years
symptoms: 4LO/4WD light blinks nonstop, refuses to shift 2H <-> 4H
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 4WD ECU fuse and actuator connector under chassis for water/mud. 2. Tap actuator housing gently while switching 2H/4H (stationary, Neutral). 3. Open actuator cap to clean rusted limit contacts.

domainName: Electronic Suspension, AWD/4WD Couplings, Diff Locks & Chassis
title: Mitsubishi Super Select 4WD Flashing Orange Center Diff Light
phContext: Mitsubishi Montero Sport / Strada; faulty 4WD detection switches
