title: Engine Stall History (Toyota) — Legitimate Diagnostic Flag
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Hilux/Fortuner ; logged whenever engine stalls
symptoms: Stored P1603 in history even after fixing fuel/battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Understand P1603 is an informational stall counter, not an ECU defect! 2. Fix underlying stall cause (dirty throttle, weak battery, SCV). 3. Clear P1603.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: ABS ECU Pump MOSFET Shorted — Pump Runs Nonstop Key-Off!
phContext: Bosch 8.0 / ATE / Denso ABS modules; welded relay or shorted FET
symptoms: Loud buzzing under hood even with key in pocket, kills battery in 1 hr
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug ABS module connector (if buzzing stops, fault is inside ABS ECU!). 2. Replace ABS hydraulic/electronic unit or internal pump MOSFET.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: TCM Solenoid Driver Open — Cold Solder on Hybrid Ceramic PCB
phContext: Ford DPS6 / Bosch/ZF Mechatronic / Jatco internal TCMs
symptoms: Solenoid circuit DTCs only when transmission fluid hits 90°C+
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify external harness and solenoid coil ohms first. 2. If fault occurs only hot, fine gold/aluminum wire-bonds inside sealed TCM ceramic substrate are lifting. 3. Replace TCM.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: BCM Flasher / Headlight Smart-FET Latched Off (Short Counter)
phContext: Modern Ford/BMW/Hyundai BCMs; 50x short-circuit counter lockout
symptoms: Bulb replaced, wiring fixed, yet headlight/park light still has 0V!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Modern BCMs use Smart-FETs that permanently latch OFF after N short-circuit trips! 2. Clear BCM DTCs AND run 'Reset Short-Circuit Counter' via diagnostic tool. 3. Test output.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: Bench Oscilloscope Ground Loop Shorts 12V Supply
phContext: Technician clipping grounded bench scope probe onto high-side 12V
symptoms: PSU trips or sparks when probing injector/coil positive!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ensure bench PSU negative and oscilloscope ground are isolated or ONLY clip scope ground to 0V reference! 2. Use differential probe or math channel (Ch1 - Ch2) for floating signals.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: Used Replacement ECU Locked by VIN / Component Protection
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Kia, Mazda, VW; swapped junkyard ECU
symptoms: Starts? No — immobilizer / VIN mismatch prevents crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read donor ECU VIN and Immobilizer ID. 2. Perform Module Initialization / Virginize EEPROM + Key Programming (or clone Flash+EEPROM from original ECU on bench). 3. Verify.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: KWP2000 / UDS Security Access Seed-Key Rejected
phContext: Tech attempting injector coding or DPF reset on locked ECU
symptoms: Scan tool says 'Security Access Denied / Conditions Not Correct'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify ignition is ON, engine OFF (for coding) and battery >12.5V! 2. Wait 10-minute security lockout timer if wrong PIN was tried 3x. 3. Use valid OEM PIN/seed-key.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: Corroded Aluminum ECU Case Ground — Thermal Paste Dried
phContext: ECUs mounted in engine bay bolted to aluminum bracket
symptoms: Intermittent misfire/reset when hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean oxidized mounting ears on ECU case and chassis bracket. 2. Ensure dedicated ground pins in connector are intact. 3. Torque mounting bolts.

domainName: Bench ECU Testing, PCB Component & Driver IC Faults (AutoElectric Lab PRO)
title: Incorrect Pinout Probe Bent Female Terminal in ECU Plug
phContext: Technician jamming thick multimeter probe into 0.64mm micro-pins!
symptoms: Brand new intermittent open circuit created during testing!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER jam standard 2mm DMM probes into ECU female terminals! 2. Always use proper 0.64mm/1.0mm backprobe needles or breakout harness. 3. Re-tension or replace spread terminal.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: BYD Blade LFP Battery Sudden SOC Drop (15% -> 0%) — Unbalanced
phContext: BYD Atto 3 / Dolphin / Sealion 6; driver charges only to 80% for months
symptoms: Range estimate jumps suddenly from 15% to 0% turtle mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. LFP chemistry has a flat voltage curve; BMS drifts without 100% top-balancing! 2. Slow-charge on AC to 100% and leave plugged in 1–2 hours so BMS balances all LFP cells. 3. Verify cell delta <20 mV.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: DC Fast Charger (CCS2) Fails Handshake at Mall Station
phContext: BYD, MG4, Hyundai Ioniq, Kia EV6 at SM/Ayala DC chargers
symptoms: Charger says 'Communication Error' or stops at 0 kW
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V battery voltage and inspect CCS2 port pins for bent/dirty CP/PP pins. 2. Hold charging plug slightly upward during first 15 sec of handshake (heavy cable weight tilts lock!). 3. Verify lock actuator clicks.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Drive Motor A Control Module — IGBT Over-Temp (Traffic/Hill)
phContext: HEV/EVs climbing steep Baguio/Antipolo grades in 38°C heat
symptoms: Power reduced warning, tortoise icon on dash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Inverter IGBT Temp 1–3 PIDs. 2. Check inverter electric coolant pump flow and bleed air! 3. Inspect lower bumper radiator/chiller fins for plastic bags/mud.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid/EV Battery Isolation Sensor Circuit — HV A/C Leak
phContext: HEV/EVs with HV electric scroll compressor; moisture/oil contamination
symptoms: P0AA7/P0AA6 sets ONLY when A/C turns on!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clear DTC and turn A/C OFF: if car enters READY without fault, then faults the instant A/C turns on, the HV A/C compressor or its orange cable is leaking to ground! 2. Megger-test compressor at 500V.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) Discharge Won't Output 220V
phContext: BYD, MG4, Hyundai/Kia EVs using V2L adapter for camping/brownout
symptoms: V2L adapter plugs in, screen says 'Discharging Failed'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HV Battery SOC (most EVs lock out V2L below 15–20% SOC!). 2. Measure V2L adapter internal PP resistor value (must match OEM spec, e.g., 2.0 kΩ). 3. Check load <2.2–3.6 kW.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: DC-DC Converter Status Circuit Low — Shorted 12V Load
phContext: HEV/EVs with heavy aftermarket audio/lights overloading DC-DC
symptoms: 12V battery drains, DC-DC shuts down thermally
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure 12V accessory draw with clamp meter (most HEV DC-DCs cap at 100–130A!). 2. Check DC-DC liquid cooling loop. 3. Disconnect overload and test.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Control Pilot (CP) / Proximity Pilot (PP) Pin Corrosion
phContext: EVs charged outdoors in monsoon rain without port rubber cap
symptoms: AC charging drops to 6A or fails to detect gun plugged in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect top two small pins (CP and PP) inside Type-2 / CCS2 inlet for green oxidation or recessed pin. 2. Measure PP-to-PE resistance with gun plugged (e.g., 220 Ω for 32A cable). 3. Clean/replace charge port.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Generator Inverter (MG1) Performance — Toyota/BYD EHS
phContext: Toyota Corolla Cross/Zenix HEV, BYD DM-i; phase current sensor
symptoms: Hybrid warning, engine won't charge battery
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read MG1/MG2 phase current and resolver PIDs. 2. Inspect 3-phase orange busbar bolts inside inverter (must be torqued cleanly). 3. Check inverter coolant.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Battery Chiller / 3-Way Coolant Valve Stuck — Slow DC Fast Charge
phContext: BYD, MG4, Hyundai EVs; jammed multi-way thermal management valve
symptoms: DC fast charge throttled to 20 kW, battery temp >48°C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Command 3-way/4-way coolant valves via scan tool while watching HV Battery Temp vs. Chiller Temp. 2. Check A/C refrigerant charge (EVs cool HV battery via A/C chiller!). 3. Replace stuck coolant valve.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: DC-DC Converter Input Voltage Low — Blown HV Fuse
phContext: HEVs/EVs after minor accident or pyro-fuse activation
symptoms: 12V not charging, HV pack disconnected
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HV main fuse and pyro-fuse status PID (airbag crash triggers pyro-fuse permanently!). 2. Verify SMR contactors close cleanly. 3. Replace blown HV fuse.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Auxiliary Transmission Fluid Pump Motor Stalled (HEV/PHEV)
phContext: Toyota, Hyundai/Kia HEV/PHEV, BYD DM-i; e-pump cooling transaxle
symptoms: Hybrid overheat or shifting shudder, P0C2A
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check transaxle e-pump 12V/3-phase fuse and fluid level (must use OEM non-conductive e-ATF!). 2. Command electric oil pump ON via scan tool. 3. Replace seized e-pump.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Cabin Heater (PTC) Dead — Weak Defogging in Baguio Rain
phContext: BEVs (Atto 3, Dolphin, MG4); blown HV PTC heater fuse or element
symptoms: A/C cools fine, setting temp to 28°C still blows cold air
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check HV PTC heater current PID when heat is set to MAX (should draw 2–5 kW). 2. Inspect HV fuse inside junction box (PDU). 3. Check coolant valve routing if heat-pump equipped.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: High Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) Open — Unseated Orange Plug
phContext: EV/PHEV after service; any orange HV connector latch not clicked
symptoms: READY mode blocked, P0A0A
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect HVIL continuity loop through Inverter, HV Battery, PDU, A/C Compressor, and PTC Heater orange plugs! 2. Reseat every orange connector until secondary lock clicks. 3. Clear DTC.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Range Suddenly Drops 30% — Dragging Brake or Wrong Tire
phContext: EVs fitted with heavy non-EV replacement tires or sticky caliper
symptoms: Wh/km consumption jumps from 140 to 210 Wh/km
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check tire pressures (EVs often require 36–42 psi!) and rolling resistance rating. 2. Jack all 4 wheels to check for dragging brake caliper. 3. Check alignment.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Battery Negative Contactor Stuck Closed — Welded Relay
phContext: High-mileage HEVs; SMRG contactor welded shut
symptoms: HV warning on, P0AA4
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor SMRG status PID at key-off. 2. Disconnect 12V and HV service plug (with 1000V gloves!) and test contactor resistance. 3. Replace SMR relay block.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Drive Motor A Over-Temperature — Stator Cooling Blocked
phContext: Oil-cooled e-axles (BYD, Hyundai, Nissan); clogged oil cooler
symptoms: Power limit warning on steep climbs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check e-axle / transaxle oil level and oil-to-water heat exchanger flow. 2. Read Motor Stator Temp PID. 3. Clean clogged radiator/cooler.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Shifter Won't Leave Park — Open Hood/Charge Door Switch
phContext: BYD, MG4, Hyundai EVs; safety interlock active
symptoms: Car is READY, shifts to D/R and immediately snaps back to P!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check cluster for 'Hood Open', 'Driver Door Open', or 'Charge Port Open' indicator! 2. Inspect charge-port door microswitch (often dirty/stuck). 3. Verify seatbelt/door interlock.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: 14V Power Module System Voltage Low — Corroded Ground
phContext: HEV/EVs; loose 12V ground strap from DC-DC converter to chassis
symptoms: 12V battery reads 12.1V while DC-DC outputs 14.2V!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage directly on DC-DC housing/output stud vs. 12V battery posts. 2. Clean chassis ground strap under inverter/PDU. 3. Torque ground bolt.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: OBC (On-Board Charger) Fails at 7 kW, Works at 2.2 kW
phContext: EVs with 2-phase/3-phase OBC; one internal PFC stage failed
symptoms: Home 2.2 kW granny charger works, 7 kW mall AC charger trips error
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor OBC AC Input Current & Voltage PIDs during 7 kW charge. 2. Check Type-2 L1/N/PE pin continuity. 3. Replace faulty OBC unit if one stage failed.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Battery Current Sensor Circuit — Hall Sensor Drift
phContext: Toyota HEV, BYD; zero-current offset at idle
symptoms: SOC jumps erratically, P0AC0 stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read HV Battery Current PID at key-on READY with A/C off (must be ~0.0 to -1.0A). 2. Check 5V/GND at Hall current sensor inside HV junction block. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Regen Braking Pulsates / Jerks at 10 km/h — Motor/ABS Blend
phContext: HEVs/EVs transitioning from regen to friction brakes
symptoms: Clunk or sudden grab right before full stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect brake rotors for rust ridges (unused friction brakes!). 2. Perform brake pedal stroke sensor zero-point calibration. 3. Check for OEM ABS/VCM software update.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: PHEV / HEV Engine Won't Shut Off at Stoplights — HVAC/Temp
phContext: Corolla Cross HEV, Sealion 6 DM-i; cabin too hot or low SOC
symptoms: Engine keeps running at every stoplight in 38°C traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check A/C demand (setting Lo/18°C forces ICE/HV load high) and HV Battery Temp (>45°C inhibits EV-only!). 2. Clean HV battery cooling fan. 3. Verify ECT reaches >70°C.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Drive Motor A Current Sensor Circuit — Inverter Phase
phContext: EV/HEV inverter internal Hall current sensor
symptoms: Sudden power cut, P0C00
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read U/V/W phase current PIDs at standstill (must all read 0.0A). 2. Check inverter internal ribbon cables. 3. Replace inverter.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Pedestrian Alert Speaker Stuck ON in Park — Shorted Wire
phContext: EVs where AVAS sounder plays loudly even in Park
symptoms: Spaceship hum plays continuously in garage
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Transmission Range / Gear P status PID in VCU. 2. Scan AVAS module for CAN timeout. 3. Reboot 12V/update firmware.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Battery Positive Contactor Stuck Open — Dead Coil/Fuse
phContext: HEV/EVs; open SMRB coil or blown BMS fuse
symptoms: Car clicks once at READY attempt, fails with P0AA2
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V BMS contactor drive fuse. 2. Measure SMR coil resistance (typically 15–40 ohms) with HV pack isolated. 3. Replace contactor.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Portable EVSE Trips House Circuit Breaker Immediately
phContext: Using 16A/32A EVSE on old PH house wiring with 15A breaker
symptoms: Garage breaker trips 5 min into charging
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never run 16A/32A continuous EV load on shared 15A lighting/outlet circuit! 2. Lower EVSE current to 8A/10A temporarily. 3. Install dedicated 40A breaker + 5.5mm² THHN wire.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Battery Voltage Sensor A Circuit — Broken Sense Tab
phContext: Aged NiMH/Li-ion packs; oxidized spot-weld or broken tap
symptoms: Block voltage reads 0V or 20V, P0B24
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect voltage sense harness inside HV pack (with 1000V PPE!). 2. Check for green copper sulfate on NiMH sense rings. 3. Clean/replace sense harness.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Nissan Kicks e-POWER Generator Knock — Foul Gasoline
phContext: Nissan Kicks e-POWER; 1.2L range-extender engine running RON 91/water
symptoms: Metallic knock when battery charges, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain/test fuel sample for water/low octane. 2. Inspect spark plugs and ignition coils on 3-cylinder HR12DE. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Generator Performance — Toyota e-CVT Damper Slip
phContext: High-mileage Toyota Prius/Corolla Cross HEV; worn input damper
symptoms: Loud rattle when ICE starts/stops, P0A92
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen at transaxle bellhousing during ICE start/stop transition. 2. Check engine misfire first (misfires mimic damper rattle!). 3. Replace transaxle input damper plate.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Charge Flap Motor Frozen — Mud/Car Wash Wax
phContext: BYD/MG/Hyundai motorized or push-pop charge port door
symptoms: Charge flap refuses to pop open at charging station
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press unlock on key fob (charge flap locks with central locking!). 2. Clean rubber latch plunger and apply silicone lube. 3. Use manual release cable in trunk if motorized.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: HV Battery Isolation Fault — Coolant Leak Inside Pack
phContext: Liquid-cooled EV battery packs (BYD/MG/Hyundai); internal plate seep
symptoms: P0AA6/P0AA9 after bottoming out on speed bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect underbody battery skid plate for dents/scrapes! 2. Pressure-test battery cooling circuit and check coolant level drop. 3. Pull pack to inspect internal manifold O-rings.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Heat Pump A/C Loud Buzzing at Startup — Normal High-Speed Scroll
phContext: EVs (BYD, Hyundai, Tesla) cooling battery + cabin in 38°C PH heat
symptoms: Loud compressor hum in parking lot right after DC fast charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain HV scroll compressor runs up to 6,000+ RPM to chill HV battery after DC fast charge! 2. Verify condenser fan is unobstructed. 3. Check A/C pressure if cooling is weak.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Generator Over-Temperature — High-Speed Mountain Climb
phContext: HEVs climbing Kennon/Marcos Highway at high speed with low SOC
symptoms: Warning light, reduced speed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect transaxle/inverter coolant level and pump flow. 2. Check radiator fins for mud/insects. 3. Let cool and bleed.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV 12V Battery Replaced with Wrong Polarity / Non-AGM
phContext: DIYer installing standard battery or backwards terminals on EV
symptoms: Main 12V pyro/fusible link blown, car dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V main fuse block on positive terminal. 2. Verify exact terminal orientation and AGM/LFP spec required by OEM. 3. Scan all ECUs.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit — Loose Inverter Plug
phContext: HEV/EV after transaxle/mount work
symptoms: Jerky takeoff, P0A40
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect multi-pin resolver harness between transaxle and inverter for unseated lock tab. 2. Ohm-test resolver coils. 3. Calibrate resolver offset.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: PHEV Electric Mode Locked Out — Cold/Mountain Engine Warmup
phContext: BYD Sealion 6 DM-i / Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV; system logic
symptoms: Won't stay in pure EV mode on cold Baguio morning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ambient/battery temp and cabin heater demand (PHEVs start ICE when cabin heat or high power is requested). 2. Verify HV SOC >25%. 3. Check for stored ICE faults.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Drive Motor A Inverter Performance — Phase Short
phContext: Damaged IGBT module inside inverter
symptoms: Sudden bang/shutoff, car refuses READY
diagnosticSteps: 1. With HV isolated and discharged, measure U/V/W motor phases to chassis ground (>100 MΩ) and phase-to-phase (<0.1 Ω balanced). 2. If motor passes, replace shorted inverter.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Tire Noise / Roaring — Missing Foam Acoustic Liner
phContext: EVs with acoustic-foam tires repaired by vulcanizing shop
symptoms: Loud hollow roar at 60+ km/h after tire puncture patch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Some EV tires have glued acoustic foam inside; if loose after patch, it bunches up and causes severe imbalance/noise! 2. Rebalance or trim loose foam cleanly.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Battery Temp Sensor A Circuit — Open Thermistor
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Nissan HEV; chewed wire near rear seat/pack
symptoms: HV fan runs at 100% constantly, P0A9C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read HV Battery Temp 1–4 PIDs (one reads -40°C!). 2. Inspect thermistor connector inside/near HV pack. 3. Replace open thermistor.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: EV Fast Charge Stuck at 80% — Normal Taper / Thermal Limit
phContext: Driver waiting at mall DC charger wondering why speed dropped to 8 kW
symptoms: Charge rate drops sharply from 60 kW to 8 kW above 80% SOC
diagnosticSteps: 1. Explain normal CC-CV charging taper above 80% SOC to protect battery longevity. 2. Check if battery temp >45°C caused early taper. 3. Advise unplugging at 80–90% on DC.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Lost Comm with Drive Motor Control Module (Inverter)
phContext: HEV/EV; blown IGCT/Inverter 12V fuse or floodwater in inverter plug
symptoms: No READY mode, U0110 in VCU/HV ECU
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A/15A IGCT / Inverter 12V fuse in engine bay. 2. Inspect low-voltage control plug on inverter for water/corrosion. 3. Check CAN resistance.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: BYD / EV Infotainment Screen Rotates Slowly or Freezes — OTA
phContext: BYD Atto 3 / Dolphin; heavy app cache or interrupted OTA update
symptoms: Rotating screen lags, A/C controls sluggish
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hold volume scroll wheel on center console for 10 seconds to force-reboot Android head unit! 2. Clear unused apps/cache. 3. Check 12V battery health.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid/EV Battery Cooling Pump Control — Debris in Impeller
phContext: Liquid-cooled EVs after front radiator repair
symptoms: Battery overheat warning during DC charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Command battery coolant pump ON via scan tool and feel hose vibration. 2. Bleed air via vacuum-fill tool. 3. Replace jammed pump.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Parking Pawl Stuck on Steep Slope — Heavy EV Weight
phContext: Heavy EVs/PHEVs parked on steep garage ramp without setting EPB first
symptoms: Loud bang/resistance when shifting out of Park on incline
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always engage Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) BEFORE releasing foot brake on slopes! 2. Have helper push/rock car slightly uphill to unload parking pawl if jammed. 3. Check EPB auto-apply setting.

domainName: Hybrid & EV (HEV / PHEV / BEV) Thermal, BMS & Inverter Deep Diagnostics
title: Hybrid Powertrain Control Module Internal — 12V Brownout
phContext: HEV/EVs cranked/booted with dying 12V battery (<9V)
symptoms: Random P0A1D latch, clears after 12V replacement
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test and replace weak 12V auxiliary battery. 2. Clear all HV/VCU codes and perform 3 drive cycles. 3. Verify DC-DC charging.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Honda ACG Starter / CKP Sensor Open — Stator Melt / Flood
phContext: Honda Click 125/160, PCX, ADV, Beat; muddy water in stator cover
symptoms: No crank (silent!), MIL blinks 5 long + 2 short (Code 52)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 3-phase heavy stator plug & 6-pin CKP Hall sensor plug near right crankcase for melted plastic or mud! 2. Check ACG main relay & 30A fuse. 3. Measure CKP 5V/GND and 4-channel Hall outputs.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Yamaha Aerox / NMAX Error 12 — Melted Stator-to-ECU Plug
phContext: Yamaha Aerox 155 / NMAX 155; notorious high-resistance stator connector
symptoms: Engine dies suddenly in traffic, 'Er_12' on cluster, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove right side fairing and inspect white 3-pin/6-pin stator-to-SGCU connector (often visibly melted brown/black!). 2. Cut out burnt connector, solder & heat-shrink wires directly! 3. Clear Error 12.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Scooter TPS Sensor Flat Spot — High-Mileage Throttle Cycling
phContext: Honda Click/Beat, Yamaha Mio/NMAX; worn carbon track at 1/4 throttle
symptoms: Hesitates/bogs at 30–40 km/h, pops on decel, MIL Code 8
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read TPS voltage at closed throttle (spec ~0.48–0.55V) and sweep slowly to WOT (~4.5V) — look for sudden drop to 0V! 2. Replace TPS sensor and perform ECM TP Reset.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Scooter IACV (Idle Air Control Valve) Stuck — Carbon / Rain
phContext: Honda Click/PCX, Yamaha Mio/NMAX; dirt clogging stepper pintle
symptoms: Stalls every time throttle is released at stoplights, hard start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove IACV from throttle body and clean black carbon from pintle & air bypass passage. 2. Verify stepper motor coils (typically 40–60 ohms) and smooth rotation at key-on. 3. Reset ECM.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Fuel Pump Weak (<250 kPa) — Clogged Strainer Sock (E10/Dirt)
phContext: All PH EFI motorcycles/scooters >25,000 km; rusty/dirty fuel
symptoms: Starts and idles fine, bogs/dies above 60 km/h or uphill
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tee fuel pressure gauge into tank-to-injector line (spec 294 kPa / 43 psi!). 2. Pull fuel pump from tank and replace brown/black clogged tea-bag filter sock. 3. Check pump current.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Scooter Smart Key (Keyless) Won't Turn Knob — Weak Fob / 12V
phContext: Honda PCX/ADV/Click 160, Yamaha NMAX/Aerox ABS
symptoms: Pressing knob gives no beep, cannot turn ignition to ON
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check smart key LED color & replace CR2032 battery (>3.0V). 2. Measure motorcycle 12V battery (if <11.5V, SCU won't unlock knob!). 3. Use emergency 6-digit ID pin override procedure.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: MAP / Manifold Absolute Pressure Sensor Fault — Clogged Hose
phContext: Honda/Yamaha/Suzuki EFI bikes; cracked vacuum hose or flooded sensor
symptoms: Rich running, black spark plug, stalls at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read MAP kPa at key-on (~101 kPa) and idle (30–40 kPa). 2. Inspect rubber hose to throttle body for cracks. 3. Check 5V VREF at 3-pin/5-pin sensor unit.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: ECT / EOT Engine Temp Sensor Fault — Broken Wire at Cylinder
phContext: Liquid-cooled (Click/NMAX) or oil-cooled (Mio/Raider) bikes
symptoms: Radiator fan runs nonstop, rich fuel consumption, overheat light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin sensor on cylinder head for snapped wire from vibration. 2. Measure resistance cold (~2.5 kΩ at 25°C) vs. hot (~200–300 Ω). 3. Bleed cooling system if liquid-cooled.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Bank Angle / Tip-Over Sensor Stuck — Mounted Upside Down
phContext: Suzuki Raider FI, Yamaha R15/NMAX, Honda CBR/ADV; after crash/fairing work
symptoms: Cranks normally, zero spark and zero fuel pump prime!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check tip-over sensor under seat/front fairing: 'UP' arrow MUST point straight up! 2. Measure output voltage (~0.4–1.4V level, >3.5V tilted). 3. Replace stuck pendulum sensor.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Sidestand Kill Switch Stuck — Scooter Won't Crank
phContext: Honda Click/PCX/ADV, Yamaha Aerox/NMAX; mud jamming plunger
symptoms: Dash lights up, brake light works, zero starter response
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flip sidestand up/down firmly and spray contact cleaner into pivot switch. 2. Check continuity across 2-pin sidestand switch under floorboard (must close when stand UP). 3. Replace switch.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Brake Light Switch Stuck/Open — Scooter Won't Crank
phContext: All automatic scooters (must hold brake lever to crank!)
symptoms: Starter silent unless other brake lever is squeezed hard
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze left vs. right brake lever and check if rear tail brake light turns ON! 2. Clean/replace faulty microswitch under brake lever perch. 3. Test starter.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Yamaha NMAX/Aerox Error 42 — Front/Rear ABS Wheel Speed Sensor
phContext: Yamaha NMAX/Aerox ABS, Honda ADV/PCX ABS; broken wire on fork
symptoms: Speedometer drops to 0, ABS light solid, Error 42
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect ABS sensor wire clipped along front fork / rear swingarm for rub-through against tire/disc! 2. Check tone ring for bent teeth from tire shop prybar. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Overheating Liquid-Cooled Scooter — Plastic Water Pump Gear
phContext: Honda Click 125/150/160, PCX, NMAX; dry-run or worn impeller seal
symptoms: Red temp warning light in traffic, milky oil or coolant drip from weep hole
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check coolant level directly at radiator cap (not just reserve tank!). 2. Inspect water pump mechanical seal weep hole for coolant/oil mix. 3. Bleed radiator air pocket via head bleeder.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Fuel Injector Clogged / Open — Water in Gas Tank Cap
phContext: Bikes parked in heavy rain with clogged tank-cap drain hole
symptoms: Hard start, misses above half-throttle, injector code
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean rain drain hole around fuel cap rim! 2. Measure injector coil resistance (10–13 ohms). 3. Flush injector with cleaner and drain tank water.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Charging Voltage >15.5V Cooking Battery — Failed Rectifier/Regulator
phContext: Carb & EFI motorcycles (Barako, TMX, Mio, Raider); loose battery cable
symptoms: Headlight bulbs blow instantly when revving, battery swollen hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure battery voltage at 4000 RPM (must cap at 14.2–14.8V; >15.5V = bad R/R!). 2. Check R/R ground wire! (Never run bike with battery unplugged). 3. Replace Regulator/Rectifier.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Battery Draining Overnight — Yamaha Y-Connect / GPS Module
phContext: Yamaha NMAX/Aerox with Bluetooth CCU (Y-Connect) or aftermarket GPS
symptoms: Battery dead after 3– 5 days parked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure parasitic draw key-off (spec <1–2 mA on bikes!). 2. Unplug Y-Connect CCU module under front cowl/seat to test if draw drops! 3. Update/unplug CCU or faulty GPS.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: CVT Scooter Dragging / Chattering at Takeoff — Glazed Clutch
phContext: Honda Click/Beat, Yamaha Mio/NMAX in Metro Manila delivery/traffic
symptoms: Bike shudders violently from 0–20 km/h, squeals
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull CVT cover and inspect clutch bell (blue heat spots) and shoe lining glaze. 2. Clean flyball/roller weights (flat-spotted rollers ruin top speed!) and torque drive face. 3. Blow out dust.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Motorcycle O2 Sensor Circuit — Exhaust Swap Without Bung/Plug
phContext: Bikes fitted with aftermarket open pipe; O2 sensor left dangling/cut
symptoms: MIL on, rich/popping exhaust, poor mileage
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify O2 sensor is threaded into aftermarket header bung and plugged in. 2. Check O2 voltage switching (0.1– 0.9V hot). 3. Repair cut wire.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Ignition Coil / Spark Plug Cap Resistance Open — Rain Cutout
phContext: All bikes riding through heavy rain/puddles; cracked 5 kΩ resistor cap
symptoms: Engine sputters and dies in rain, restarts when dry
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure spark plug cap resistance (spec ~5 kΩ; infinite/open = internal resistor burned!). 2. Inspect high-tension lead for cracks arcing to frame. 3. Replace spark plug cap with waterproof OEM.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Idling Stop System (ISS) Not Working on Honda Click/PCX
phContext: Honda scooters with ISS switch ON; weak battery or idle too high
symptoms: Engine doesn't shut off at traffic lights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ISS switch on right handlebar and coolant temp (>60°C required). 2. Check battery voltage (>12.4V required) and idle RPM (must be 1600– 1700 RPM, not adjusted high!). 3. Verify VSS works.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Scooter ECM EEPROM / Immobilizer Error — Jump-Start Surge
phContext: Cars/jump-packs used carelessly on small 12V bike batteries
symptoms: MIL on solid, erratic running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify charging voltage (14.4V). 2. Perform ECM Reset via DLC red 4/6-pin jumper or diagnostic tool. 3. Replace ECM if EEPROM corrupt.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Tricycle / Barako FI Hard Starting — Valve Clearance Too Tight
phContext: Kawasaki Barako 175 FI, Honda TMX Supremo; heavy commercial load
symptoms: Cranks easily, zero start when hot, pops back through intake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check intake/exhaust valve clearances cold (tight zero-lash exhaust/intake valves lose compression hot!). 2. Adjust tappets to OEM spec (e.g., 0.08–0.12 mm). 3. Check compression.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Valve Cover / Stator Grommet Oil Leak Fouling Belt
phContext: Scooters; oil seeping into CVT case causing belt slip
symptoms: Bike revs high, moves slowly, burning rubber smell
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open CVT cover and check for wet oil sling inside housing. 2. Replace leaking crankshaft oil seal behind variator (or gear oil seal behind clutch). 3. Wash pulley faces & replace belt.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Aftermarket LED Headlight / MDL Draining Scooter Battery
phContext: Delivery riders running 2x 40W Mini Driving Lights on stock stator
symptoms: Battery dies after 1 hour night riding
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure stator charging current vs. total accessory load! (Most 125–150cc bikes only spare 3–5A for accessories!). 2. Wire MDL through relay + fuse and keep wattage <= 30W total.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: IAT Sensor Fault — Unplugged Airbox Sensor
phContext: Scooters after air filter cleaning
symptoms: MIL blinks 9 times, sluggish throttle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 2-pin IAT sensor plugged into air filter housing. 2. Verify 5V bias and continuity. 3. Clear ECM code.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Steering Head Bearing Notched — 'Kabig' / Pulls in Slow Turns
phContext: High-mileage scooters hitting potholes
symptoms: Handlebars snap/click into center dead-spot when turning slowly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Put bike on center stand, lift front wheel, and turn bars slowly left-right (notch at center = brinelled ball races!). 2. Replace steering stem bearing set (ball/tapered).

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: ABS Modulator Locked / Spongy Brake — Never Flushed DOT4
phContext: NMAX/ADV/PCX ABS; 3-year-old moisture-laden brake fluid
symptoms: Brake lever pulls to grip, ABS light flashes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Flush brake fluid completely with fresh DOT4. 2. Cycle ABS modulator solenoids via motorcycle scan tool to purge trapped air. 3. Check master cylinder piston.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Kill Switch / Engine Stop Switch Corroded — Rain Exposure
phContext: Motorcycles parked outdoors in rain; oxidized red kill switch
symptoms: Cranks or doesn't crank, zero spark
diagnosticSteps: 1. Toggle red Engine Kill switch 10x rapidly while watching if fuel pump primes. 2. Open right switchgear, clean copper contacts, and apply dielectric grease. 3. Test.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Fuel Cap Vapor Lock — Blocked Tank Vent Hose
phContext: Motorcycles stalling every 15 minutes, restarting after opening gas cap
symptoms: Bike dies cleanly as if out of gas, hisses loudly when cap opened!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open fuel cap the instant bike stalls: if loud air suction hiss occurs and bike restarts immediately, tank vent is pinched! 2. Inspect vent hose under tank for kink. 3. Clear vent.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Rear Hub / Final Drive Gear Oil Milky — Flooded Breather
phContext: Scooters ridden through knee-deep floods; water in gear oil
symptoms: Whining/grinding noise from rear wheel area
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain rear gear oil (80W-90 / 10W-30 per OEM): milky gray = floodwater! 2. Flush gear case 2x with fresh oil. 3. Inspect breather tube routing.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Aftermarket Horn / Alarm Shorting Ignition Fuse
phContext: Scooters with loud dual horns wired straight to ignition wire
symptoms: Entire bike dies the moment horn button is pressed!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure horn amperage (dual snail horns draw 8–12A, blowing 10A Main/Horn fuse!). 2. Wire horn via 30A relay directly from battery (+). 3. Replace fuse.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Honda ECU Internal / VREF Fault — Water in ECM Plug
phContext: Honda Click/ADV with low-mounted ECU near battery box
symptoms: Bike dead, Code 53 blinks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 33-pin ECM connector and inspect for green water corrosion. 2. Clean pins, dry ECU, and check all 5V sensor wires for short to ground. 3. Reset ECM.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Kickstarter Jammed / Won't Return — Dry Ratchet Gear
phContext: Scooters/underbones (Beat, Mio, TMX); rusted kickstarter shaft
symptoms: Kickstarter stays stuck down after starting
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove CVT/left cover, pull kickstarter spindle gear, clean rust, and lightly grease shaft & return spring. 2. Never force kickstarter back up with foot!

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Broken Engine Ground Wire — Starter Uses Throttle Cable as Ground!
phContext: Older bikes/tricycles with missing frame-to-engine ground strap
symptoms: Throttle cable gets smoking hot and melts during cranking!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately inspect/install thick 8– 10 AWG ground cable from battery (-) directly to starter mounting bolt/crankcase! 2. Replace melted throttle cable.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Stator AC Output Weak (<40V AC) — One Phase Burned
phContext: Non-ACG bikes with 3-phase charging (NMAX, Raider, Barako)
symptoms: Battery dies even while riding long distances
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 3-pin stator connector; measure resistance phase-to-phase (0.2–1.0 Ω) and each phase to ground (MUST be infinite!). 2. Measure AC voltage at 4000 RPM (40–70V AC balanced on all 3 pairs). 3. Replace stator.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Fuel Injector O-Ring Torn — Fuel Spraying on Hot Engine
phContext: Bikes after DIY throttle body cleaning
symptoms: Strong raw gas smell, fire hazard, hard start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn key ON to prime pump and visually inspect top & bottom injector O-rings for weeping! 2. Replace swollen/nicked Viton O-rings lubricated with clean oil.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Yamaha VVA (Variable Valve Actuation) Stuck — Low Oil / Solenoid
phContext: Yamaha NMAX 155 / Aerox 155 / R15; VVA indicator doesn't engage >6k RPM
symptoms: Sluggish top-end above 6,000 RPM, VVA icon missing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check engine oil level (low oil prevents VVA!). 2. Test VVA solenoid on cylinder head with 12V (must click) and check pin travel. 3. Check wiring to ECU.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Scooter Drive Belt Snapped — Overdue 24,000 km Replacement
phContext: High-mileage delivery scooters; ignored belt cracks
symptoms: Engine revs freely, rear wheel won't move, shredded rubber in CVT
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove CVT cover, clear all belt fibers from behind clutch & variator! 2. Inspect pulley faces for grooves. 3. Install OEM-length Kevlar belt.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Digital Speedometer LCD Sun-Burned (Polarizer Film)
phContext: Motorcycles parked outdoors in PH sun daily; faded polarizers
symptoms: Speedo screen looks blank/washed out in daylight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect LCD glass at an angle with polarized sunglasses (if digits appear, LCD is fine and only polarizer film is sun-burnt!). 2. Peel and replace top polarizer film.

domainName: Motorcycle / Tricycle EFI & Scooter Diagnostics (PH Commuter Fleet)
title: Tricycle Sidecar Load Burning Clutch Plates Every 3 Months
phContext: Heavy commercial tricycles (Barako/TMX) with wrong oil / tight cable
symptoms: Clutch slips on hills, engine revs without accelerating
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify 2–3 mm freeplay at clutch lever! 2. Use JASO MA/MA2 motorcycle oil ONLY (car energy-conserving oil causes wet clutch slip!). 3. Replace burnt friction plates & springs.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: HiAce / Urvan Overheating in Traffic — Clogged Under-Floor Condenser
phContext: Toyota HiAce Commuter/Grandia, Nissan NV350; rear A/C condenser mud
symptoms: Engine temp climbs with dual A/C on, rear A/C blows warm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect under-chassis auxiliary A/C condenser & fan (under middle floor!) — packed solid with road mud! 2. Test auxiliary fan motor and 30A relay. 3. Wash fins gently.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: HiAce / L300 Under-Seat Engine Heat Soak — Cooking Wiring Loom
phContext: Cab-over / mid-engine vans (HiAce, Urvan, L300, Traviz)
symptoms: Brittle crumbling sensor connectors above valve cover
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect injector, FRP, and CMP harness connectors under front seats for heat-cracked plastic locks and brittle wires. 2. Wrap repaired loom in fiberglass heat sleeve. 3. Check seat-box rubber seal.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Modern PUV (Euro-4 Cummins/Yuchai/Isuzu) Fuel Rail Low — Lift Pump
phContext: Class 2/3 Modern Jeepneys; weak electric lift pump or clogged pre-filter
symptoms: Stalls climbing flyovers with 25 passengers, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check primary Racor/water-separator filter on chassis rail for algae/wax. 2. Measure low-pressure supply before HP pump (spec 300– 500 kPa). 3. Replace lift pump/filter.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Reefer Box (Refrigerated Truck) Draining Chassis Alternator
phContext: Isuzu Elf / Hino 300 with DC-powered or standby reefer unit
symptoms: Main truck batteries die during deliveries, low voltage alarms
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure reefer compressor/evaporator fan amp draw at idle vs. alternator output. 2. Verify dedicated 2nd alternator or upgraded 80A–110A 24V alternator is installed & belt tight. 3. Check isolator relay.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Modern PUV Automatic Sliding/Folding Door Jammed — Limit Switch
phContext: Class 2/3 Modern PUVs; passenger door stuck open/closed
symptoms: Driver buzzer sounds nonstop, door refuses to cycle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect pneumatic/electric door actuator air pressure (or 24V motor) and optical pinch-strip edge! 2. Clean dirt from bottom door track roller. 3. Adjust magnetic limit switches.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: UV Express Van Rear A/C Evaporator Freezing — Missing Thermostat
phContext: Vans with bypassed rear A/C expansion/thermistor by roadside shop
symptoms: Ice blocks rear ceiling vents after 1 hour on SLEX
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear A/C unit behind right/left quarter panel for missing or unclipped evaporator thermistor. 2. Restore OEM thermistor and verify compressor cycling. 3. Check rear drain hose.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Modern PUV DPF Clogged — Driver Skipping Stationary Regen
phContext: Urban PUVs crawling 10– 20 km/h for 14 hours/day
symptoms: Limp mode at 20 km/h, DPD/DPF buzzer screaming
diagnosticSteps: 1. Educate drivers NEVER to turn off engine when auto-regen is active! 2. Perform parked forced regen after checking oil level for diesel dilution. 3. Inspect DOC/DPF for ash.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Van Sliding Door Central Lock / Power Window Dead — Broken Contacts
phContext: HiAce Super Grandia, Staria, Starex; dirty brass B-pillar contact pins
symptoms: Sliding door won't lock with remote or power door fails
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean spring-loaded brass contact pins on sliding door front edge and B-pillar striker plate with eraser/contact cleaner! 2. Inspect door pinch-sensor strip. 3. Test actuator.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Traviz / L300 / H-100 Clutch Slipping — Overloaded Cargo
phContext: Light commercial cab-chassis trucks carrying 2+ tons daily
symptoms: Engine revs up in 4th/5th gear on inclines without speed gain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check clutch pedal freeplay (must have 10–15 mm freeplay at top; zero freeplay rides throwout bearing!). 2. Bleed slave cylinder. 3. Replace clutch disc, pressure plate & machine flywheel.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Fleet Truck / Van Speedometer Dead + Harsh Shifts — PTO/VSS Tap
phContext: Fleet trucks with GPS speed-limiter spliced into VSS wire
symptoms: Speedo drops to 0, odometer stops, AT shifts late
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect transmission tailhousing VSS plug for botched Scotch-Lock T-taps from GPS/telematics! 2. Measure VSS signal on scope with aftermarket tap disconnected. 3. Solder & insulate properly.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Commercial Van EGR Cooler Clogged — Heavy Idle Soot
phContext: HiAce, Urvan, H-100, Traviz; 5+ hours daily idling waiting at terminals
symptoms: Sluggish takeoff, black smoke, high EGT
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove EGR valve and cooler assembly; inspect honeycomb tubes for complete soot blockage. 2. Pressure-test cooler for coolant leaks while off. 3. Soak/clean and reinstall.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Roof-Mounted PUV A/C Blowing Hot — Belt Snapped / Low Charge
phContext: Modern PUVs with 2nd roof-mounted A/C compressor
symptoms: Cab A/C cold, passenger roof A/C blows hot air
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect secondary belt-driven roof A/C compressor under chassis/engine side. 2. Check dedicated 24V roof A/C fuse, condenser fan, and pressure switch. 3. Leak-test long roof lines.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Brake Booster Vacuum Pump Oil Seal Leak (Diesel Vans)
phContext: HiAce 2KD, L300 4D56, Urvan YD25; alternator-rear vacuum pump
symptoms: Oil dripping from under alternator, weak brakes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect oil feed/return hoses at rear of alternator-mounted vacuum pump (burst rubber hose dumps entire engine oil in 2 minutes!). 2. Replace hoses & vacuum pump shaft seal. 3. Test vacuum (-75 kPa).

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Rear Axle Wheel Seal Blown — Brake Shoes Soaked in Gear Oil
phContext: HiAce, L300, Isuzu Elf; clogged rear axle breather!
symptoms: One rear brake grabs/locks or has zero hold, gear oil on inside of tire
diagnosticSteps: 1. CRITICAL: Clean rusted/mud-plugged breather vent on top of rear axle housing! (Pressure blows axle seals!). 2. Replace rear axle oil seal, bearing, and oil-soaked brake shoes.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Modern PUV Cashless / CCTV / GPS System Killing 24V Batteries
phContext: PUVs parked overnight with AFCS/CCTV DVR wired to Constant 24V
symptoms: Bus/PUV won't crank at 4 AM terminal dispatch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure overnight parasitic draw of AFCS validator, Wi-Fi router, and 4-cam DVR. 2. Install programmable low-voltage disconnect timer (cuts DVR 30 min after key-off). 3. Test batteries.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Van MAF Sensor Fouled — Cheap Aftermarket Paper Air Filter
phContext: Fleet vans using P150 paper filters that shred or leak dust
symptoms: Black smoke, P0101, turbo compressor wheel sandblasted!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clean side of intake hose for fine dust film (dust = filter leak!). 2. Replace with OEM-grade air filter and clean MAF. 3. Inspect turbo compressor blades for erosion.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: HiAce / Urvan Glow Plug Busbar Shorted — Melted Insulator
phContext: High-mileage diesel vans; dropped wrench or cracked ceramic washer
symptoms: 100A main glow fuse blows instantly at key-on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unbolt aluminum glow busbar and inspect plastic/phenolic insulating washers on each glow plug stud! 2. Test busbar-to-head resistance (must be infinite with plugs disconnected). 3. Replace insulators.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Heavy Steering Vibration on Van at 70 km/h — Center Bearing
phContext: Long-wheelbase HiAce/Urvan/Elf; torn rubber driveshaft carrier
symptoms: Floorboard thumps/vibrates on acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Grab driveshaft near center carrier bearing and push up/down (excessive rubber sag/tear = bad!). 2. Check U-joints for binding. 3. Replace center bearing assembly.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Foton / Isuzu / Hino EGT Sensor Melted — Exhaust Clamp Leak
phContext: Commercial trucks with exhaust gas leak blowing hot soot onto EGT wire
symptoms: DPF fault, EGT reads open
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check V-band clamp near turbo/DPF for black soot streak pointing at EGT pigtail! 2. Fix exhaust leak and replace burned EGT sensor.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Door Ajar / Buzzer Stays On — Bent Rear Hatch Striker
phContext: Cargo vans (HiAce, Urvan, L300) slammed hard with cargo inside
symptoms: Interior dome light stays on, door-open warning chimes while driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear hatch/tailgate latch microswitch and striker alignment. 2. Adjust rubber bump stops so latch clicks fully to second detent. 3. Clean switch.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: 24V Trailer / Body Tail-Light Converter Shorted
phContext: Wingvans/flatbeds with aftermarket LED tail lamps
symptoms: Turn signals bleed into brake lights, blown tail fuse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear chassis tail-light junction box for water intrusion and twisted-tape splices! 2. Replace corroded splices with waterproof junction box. 3. Check ground wire to cargo box.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Turbo Boost Sensor High — Intercooler Pipe Blown Off Under Load
phContext: Commercial vans/trucks; boost hose popped off clamp on highway
symptoms: Loud 'BANG', sudden zero power, thick black smoke
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check all intercooler silicone couplers and T-bolt clamps! 2. Clean oil off metal pipe bead before reclamping so hose doesn't slip off again. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Power Steering Fluid Boiling Over — Clogged Reservoir Screen
phContext: Hard-working delivery vans (HiAce/L300/Elf) doing constant U-turns
symptoms: PS fluid foams out of cap, groaning pump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine light into PS reservoir bottom (fine brass/nylon mesh screen clogs with black sludge, starving pump!). 2. Flush system and clean/replace reservoir. 3. Check PS cooler loop.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Diesel Fuel Line Air Intrusion at Banjo Bolt — Copper Washers
phContext: Vans after injector/pump service reusing old crushed copper washers
symptoms: Hard start every morning, rough idle for 30 sec
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always replace crushable copper/aluminum banjo washers (or anneal) whenever loosening fuel lines! 2. Check for wet diesel weep around filter head & HP pump.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Smart Alternator / Battery Sensor Fault on Modern Van (Staria/Traviz)
phContext: Hyundai Staria, newer HiAce 300; BMS disconnected
symptoms: Battery warning, Stop-Start disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect negative battery post BMS sensor plug. 2. Check LIN wire continuity to ECM. 3. Reset BMS.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Rear Leaf Spring Shackle Pin Seized/Broken — Clunk on Takeoff
phContext: Overloaded delivery vans/trucks
symptoms: Loud clunk from rear when accelerating or braking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear spring shackles and greasable pins for snapped bolts or elongated eye bushings. 2. Replace bushings and grease shackles.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Cab-Tilt Safety Latch Sensor Stuck — Truck Won't Crank/Beeps
phContext: Isuzu/Hino/Fuso cab-over trucks; muddy cab-lock microswitch
symptoms: Cab-tilt warning buzzer screams, starter locked out
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lower cab firmly until both latches click. 2. Inspect 2-pin cab-lock switch behind driver seat/cab mount for mud or bent arm. 3. Clean & adjust switch.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Wiper Linkage Popped Off Ball Joint — Monsoon Failure
phContext: High-mileage vans/trucks; worn plastic wiper linkage bushings
symptoms: Wiper motor hums, one or both wiper arms sit dead on glass
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove cowl grille and inspect steel linkage rods under windshield. 2. Replace worn nylon ball-socket bushings (or entire linkage arm). 3. Verify motor park position before bolting arms.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Alternator Pulley Belt Squeal Only When A/C + Headlights ON
phContext: Commercial vans with worn V-belt or stretched serpentine belt
symptoms: Ear-piercing screech at night in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check belt tension/deflection and inspect pulley V-grooves for glazed/shiny bottoming-out! 2. Replace worn belts in matched pairs (if dual V-belt). 3. Check alternator bracket bushings.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: 24V Glow Plug Relay Stuck ON — Melts All 4 Glow Plugs
phContext: Isuzu Elf / Hino / Fuso; welded 24V glow relay contacts
symptoms: All 4 glow plugs swollen/burned open, dead batteries
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test glow relay output wire at KOEO (must shut off after 5–15 sec!). 2. Replace welded 24V relay BEFORE installing new glow plugs! 3. Check glow timer/ECM driver.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Cooling Fan Shroud Broken — Poor Airflow in Traffic
phContext: Vans/trucks where mechanic left off lower half of plastic fan shroud
symptoms: Overheats in traffic even with brand new radiator and fan clutch!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify complete 360-degree fan shroud is installed (without shroud, fan recirculates hot air instead of pulling through radiator!). 2. Reinstall missing shroud.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Fuel Tank Pickup Screen Blocked by Plastic Bottle Seal Foil
phContext: Fleet trucks where drivers dropped foil cap seals into tank!
symptoms: Truck stalls randomly at highway speed, restarts after sitting 2 min
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect supply line at tank and blow air back: if flow restores briefly then chokes again, floating foil/debris is sucking onto pickup sock! 2. Drop/clean tank.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Brake Shoe Return Spring Broken — Hot Rear Drum & Drag
phContext: Commercial vans/PUVs; fatigued drum brake spring
symptoms: Scraping noise, smoking rear wheel, burning brake smell
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear brake drum and inspect all return/hold-down springs. 2. Replace hardware spring kit on both sides + check wheel cylinder seals cooked by heat.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Steering Gearbox Play (Recirculating Ball) — Wandering Truck
phContext: Isuzu Elf, Hino, L300, older Pajero; worn sector shaft adjustment
symptoms: Truck wanders across lane on NLEX, requires constant correction
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check tie rods/kingpins first. 2. If linkage is tight, adjust sector-shaft lash screw on top of steering box (tiny 1/4 turn increments ONLY — over-tightening binds steering!).

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Starter Solenoid Ground Return Weak — Painted Engine Block
phContext: Rebuilt commercial engines freshly painted thick enamel
symptoms: Slow crank, starter housing gets hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scrape paint off starter mounting flange and flywheel housing mating face! 2. Run dedicated ground strap from starter mounting bolt directly to battery negative. 3. Retest.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Fleet Gasoline Van Catalytic Converter Melted — LPG / Poor Tune
phContext: Older converted LPG/gasoline taxis & vans running lean
symptoms: Loss of power, rattling exhaust, P0420
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check LPG mixer/injector calibration and ignition health. 2. Measure exhaust backpressure. 3. Replace melted catalyst.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Headlight High-Beam / Dimmer Switch Melted on Column
phContext: Older HiAce/L300/Elf running 100W halogen bulbs without relays
symptoms: Headlights cut out completely on bumpy dark roads!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace burnt column combination switch. 2. Install dual 40A headlight relays directly from battery so column switch only carries 0.2A trigger current!

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Tachometer Jumps Wildly on Diesel — Alternator W-Terminal Loose
phContext: Older mechanical-diesel trucks/vans (tacho driven by alternator W-pin)
symptoms: Tachometer needle bounces to 5000 RPM or drops to 0
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 'W' (AC phase tap) spade terminal on rear of alternator for loose fit/corrosion. 2. Measure AC frequency on W-terminal. 3. Crimp tight terminal.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Aircon Compressor Bracket Cracked — Severe Diesel Vibration
phContext: L300, HiAce, Elf; missing rear support brace bolt on A/C bracket
symptoms: A/C belt keeps throwing off or snapping every month
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect cast-iron/aluminum A/C compressor mounting bracket for hairline cracks or missing rear support bolt! 2. Weld/replace bracket and torque all braces.

domainName: Light Commercial Vans, Modern PUVs (Class 1–3) & Reefer/Fleet Trucks
title: Battery Box Cover Missing — Metal Tool Shorting Positive Post
phContext: Cab-over trucks/vans with batteries under passenger seat or frame
symptoms: Sparks/fire risk when seat drops or cargo shifts onto battery!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always install red rubber positive terminal boot AND plastic battery box lid! 2. Secure battery with proper hold-down frame.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Crankshaft Position System Variation Not Learned — Post-Clutch/CKP
phContext: Ford, Chevrolet, Hyundai, Nissan; after clutch, flywheel, or CKP swap
symptoms: MIL on (often flashing at high RPM) despite smooth running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform Crankshaft Position (CKP) Profile / Variation Learn via scan tool (usually requires revving to fuel-cut ~4000–5000 RPM in Neutral warm). 2. Verify P0315 clears.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: High Idle (1500 RPM) After Cleaning Electronic Throttle Body
phContext: Nissan Almera/Navara, Toyota Vios, Honda City; unlearned idle
symptoms: Customer complains idle is higher AFTER tune-up than before!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never manually force butterfly open on some Nissan/Honda ETCs! 2. Perform Throttle Closed Position Learn + Idle Air Volume Learning (IAVL) via scan tool (warm >80°C, all loads OFF).

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Misfire / Rough Idle After Timing Belt Job — 1 Tooth Off
phContext: Mitsubishi 4D56, Honda, Toyota; slipped cam/balance belt tooth
symptoms: No timing DTC on older cars, yet sluggish, vacuum low (14 inHg), rough
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check intake manifold vacuum at idle (normal 18–21 inHg; <15 inHg = retarded cam timing!). 2. Verify TDC crank mark aligns with cam mark. 3. Re-time belt.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Engine Vibration After Timing Belt — Balance Shaft 180° Out
phContext: Mitsubishi 4D56 / 4G63 / Hyundai D4BH; oil pump balance shaft off-phase
symptoms: Violent engine buzz/vibration at 2500–3500 RPM after belt change!
diagnosticSteps: 1. On 4D56, the oil pump balance shaft gear turns 2:1, so alignment mark can look right while 180° out of phase! 2. Remove side-block inspection plug and insert 8mm Phillips screwdriver (>60mm depth = in phase). 3. Re-time.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: No-Start After Engine Overhaul — Missing ECU/Block Ground Strap
phContext: Any newly overhauled engine; painter/mechanic forgot cylinder head ground
symptoms: Starter cranks weakly or ECM dead, zero spark/fuel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ALL ground straps (battery-to-chassis, chassis-to-transmission, cylinder-head-to-firewall)! 2. Measure voltage drop from engine head to battery (-) during crank (<0.3V). 3. Bolt grounds to bare metal.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Swapped Sensor Connectors (Same 2-Pin Plug) After Reassembly
phContext: Mechanic swapped Knock/ECT, VVT/Cam, or Purge/IACV identical plugs!
symptoms: Instant sensor codes + weird behavior right after engine work
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check wire colors at BOTH plugs against OEM wiring diagram! (Swapping 2-pin EVAP and VVT or Speed and Reverse plugs is a classic post-overhaul error!). 2. Correct plugs.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Oil Pressure Light Flickers at Hot Idle After Overhaul — Wrong Bearing
phContext: Rebuilt engines with loose rod/main clearance or missing oil gallery plug
symptoms: Oil light comes on at hot stoplights, turns off above 1200 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil viscosity and attach mechanical gauge immediately! 2. Inspect if rear/front oil gallery plug or piston cooling jet was left out during rebuild. 3. Check oil pump relief valve.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Brake Pedal High & Wheels Lock Up After Booster Replacement
phContext: Cars after brake booster/master cylinder swap; pushrod too long!
symptoms: All 4 brakes slowly lock up solid after 10 minutes of driving!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check brake booster-to-master-cylinder pushrod clearance! (Zero freeplay blocks master cylinder compensating port so thermal expansion locks brakes!). 2. Adjust pushrod length ~0.5–1.0 mm gap.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: ABS Light On After CV Axle Replacement — Wrong Tooth Count
phContext: Aftermarket CV axle installed with 44 teeth instead of 48 teeth!
symptoms: ABS light triggers at 40+ km/h, false ABS activation
diagnosticSteps: 1. Graph all 4 wheel speed PIDs at steady 40 km/h (one wheel reads 8– 10% higher/lower!). 2. Count tone ring teeth on old vs. new CV axle. 3. Install exact tooth-count ring/axle.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Power Window Auto-Up Stops Working After Battery Replacement
phContext: Toyota, Honda, Mazda, Mitsubishi; lost pinch-limit memory
symptoms: One-touch auto up/down disabled on driver/all windows
diagnosticSteps: 1. Roll window all the way DOWN, then hold switch UP until closed and keep holding UP for 3–5 seconds! 2. Repeat on each auto-enabled door. 3. Test one-touch.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Sunroof Only Tilts/Moves in Short Jerks After Battery Disconnect
phContext: SUVs/crossovers with panoramic/moonroof; lost home position
symptoms: Sunroof won't auto-close
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press and hold Sunroof Close/Tilt switch continuously through full open/close initialization cycle (10–15 sec) until motor clicks! 2. Test auto-open/close.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Steering Wheel Crooked After Alignment — Tie Rods Unequal
phContext: Vehicles after tire/suspension work; tech didn't lock steering straight
symptoms: Car drives straight with steering wheel tilted 15° left/right, ESC light!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Return to alignment rack, lock steering wheel dead-center with bubble level, and adjust left/right tie rods equally! 2. Reset SAS zero-point.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Car Pulls to Right on Crowned PH Roads — Normal vs. Caster/Tire
phContext: Driver complains of slight drift on sloped provincial roads
symptoms: Pulls right on right-sloped road, drives straight in center lane
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test drive on flat parking lot or center lane (road crown naturally drifts cars right). 2. Swap front tires L/R to rule out radial pull. 3. Check front caster/camber.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Overheating After Water Pump Replacement — Reverse-Rotation Pump
phContext: Older V-belt/serpentine engines where wrong-rotation impeller fitted
symptoms: Engine overheats steadily after brand new pump installed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare impeller vane direction on old vs. new water pump against pulley rotation direction! 2. Check if radiator was bled properly. 3. Install correct pump.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: No-Start After Fuel Filter Change — Split / Missing O-Ring in Tank
phContext: Gasoline cars (Vios, City, Mirage) with in-tank fuel filter housing
symptoms: Cranks long, zero fuel pressure at rail despite pump humming!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull in-tank fuel pump assembly back out: check tiny black rubber O-ring between pump motor outlet and plastic filter housing (often pinched/rolled or left on old filter!). 2. Reseat O-ring with lube.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Diesel Hard Start After Filter Change — Cross-Threaded Plastic Cap
phContext: Cartridge-style diesel fuel filters (Ranger, Hilux, Montero)
symptoms: Fuel filter housing sucks air overnight, stalls in morning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect plastic filter housing threads and large O-ring for pinch/cross-thread. 2. Lubricate O-ring with clean diesel and torque cap to spec. 3. Hand-prime.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Alternator Not Charging After Rebuild — Forgotten Insulator Washer
phContext: Rebuilt alternator where B+ stud shorts to aluminum rear case
symptoms: Main 120A ALT fuse blows the instant battery cable touches post!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery and measure alternator B+ stud to housing (must NOT be 0 ohms!). 2. Disassemble and check nylon insulating bushing on B+ stud. 3. Replace insulator.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Engine Won't Shut Off With Key — Backfeeding Aftermarket Fan/Audio
phContext: Cars wired with fan/relay directly to IG1 + B+ without diode isolation
symptoms: Turn key OFF and pull key out, engine keeps running for 3 sec!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull aftermarket accessory fuses one by one with key off while engine runs-on! 2. Isolate backfeeding radiator fan / turbo timer / LED relay to switched ACC/IG1 properly.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Turbo Timer Causing Alarm / Immobilizer Conflict
phContext: Diesel pickups with aftermarket turbo timer keeping IG1 alive 2 min
symptoms: Doors won't lock with remote while turbo timer counts down, or alarm trips
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check BCM/alarm configuration (many modern cars lock out remote while IG1 is live). 2. Note: modern water-cooled turbos do not need turbo timers unless hauling heavy uphill! 3. Remove/bypass.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Wheel Bearing Roars Again 2 Months After Press — Pressed by Outer Race
phContext: Hub bearings pressed incorrectly at roadside shop
symptoms: Brand new bearing grinds loudly within 2,000 km
diagnosticSteps: 1. When pressing hub flange into inner race, NEVER support bearing only by outer race (brinells balls instantly!). 2. Always support inner race during hub press and torque axle nut with torque wrench (not air impact!).

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Clutch Doesn't Disengage After Replacement — Disc Installed Backwards
phContext: Manual transmission cars; clutch disc hub protruding toward flywheel
symptoms: Pedal feels normal, impossible to put in gear with engine running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify 'FLYWHEEL SIDE / T/M SIDE' stamp on clutch disc hub! (Backwards disc wedges damper springs against flywheel bolts!). 2. Drop transmission and flip disc correctly.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Transmission Leaks ATF After Axle Replacement — Nicked Seal Lip
phContext: FWD cars; axle splines nicked rubber seal spring during install
symptoms: Fresh red ATF dripping steadily from axle output
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull CV axle, inspect new oil seal for popped garter spring or nicked rubber lip. 2. Install new OEM seal flush and guide axle splines straight in without dragging on lip.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: New Spark Plugs Misfiring Immediately — Cracked Porcelain / Fake Plugs
phContext: Counterfeit 'Iridium' spark plugs bought online for P150 each!
symptoms: Misfire under load 1 week after tune-up, melted ground electrode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect spark plugs for counterfeit markings (crooked laser font, loose terminal nut, wrong resistance — genuine resistor plugs measure 3.5– 6.5 kΩ!). 2. Buy verified OEM plugs from authorized dealer.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Rattling Noise Only When A/C Turns On — Loose Compressor Bolt
phContext: Cars after A/C compressor replacement; missing dowel pin or loose bolt
symptoms: Metallic buzz/rattle at idle only with A/C engaged
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check all 3–4 A/C compressor mounting bolts and belt tensioner pulley bearing. 2. Ensure belt ribs sit squarely in all pulley grooves (one rib off shreds belt!).

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Check Engine Light Off, Yet Fails LTO / PETC Emission Smoke Test
phContext: Cars with cleared codes (monitors Incomplete!) or clogged air filter/PCV
symptoms: High HC/CO (gas) or high K-value opacity (diesel) at emission center
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check OBD-II Readiness Monitors (cleared codes without drive cycle fail OBD check!). 2. Inspect air filter, oil age (change dirty oil before test!), spark plugs, and EGR/injectors. 3. Complete drive cycle.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Loud Whistle at Highway Speed After Windshield Replacement
phContext: Cars with poorly bonded aftermarket windshield urethane
symptoms: High-pitched wind whistle above 80 km/h, water drip on dash in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tape over top/side windshield molding seams with painter's tape and test drive (if whistle stops, pinhole in urethane!). 2. Spray soapy water outside while blowing air inside to locate leak. 3. Reseal.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Brake Pedal Vibrates + Clunks on First Stop — Loose Lug Nuts!
phContext: Cars leaving tire shop; mechanic hand-started lugs and forgot to torque
symptoms: Wobbly wheel feel, rhythmic thump matching wheel rotation
diagnosticSteps: 1. STOP IMMEDIATELY and check all 4 wheels' lug nuts! 2. Inspect wheel hub studs and rim lug seats for ovaling. 3. Torque all lugs to spec in star pattern.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Engine Overheats After Radiator Replacement — Cardboard / Cap Plug
phContext: New aftermarket radiator with shipping plug left in ATF/port or wrong cap
symptoms: Overheats in 10 min, or ATF shoots out
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify all shipping caps removed and upper/lower hoses clamped tightly. 2. Verify radiator pressure cap rating (e.g., 1.1 bar vs. 0.9 bar) and spring depth matches neck! 3. Bleed air.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Key Won't Turn in Ignition Lock — Steering Wheel Lock Tension
phContext: Most common 'no-start' roadside call from new drivers!
symptoms: Key inserts, refuses to turn past LOCK, steering wheel stuck
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rock steering wheel firmly left and right while gently turning key! (Takes pressure off steering lock pawl). 2. Check if gear lever is fully in Park. 3. Lubricate wafer tumblers if worn.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Wiper Blades Chatter / Skip Across Glass — Wax / Rain-X Buildup
phContext: Cars washed with carnauba wax/ceramic spray over windshield
symptoms: Loud shuddering wiper noise in light rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean windshield thoroughly with glass polish / cerium oxide to strip silicone/wax film! 2. Clean wiper rubber edge with alcohol or replace silicone/rubber blades. 3. Check wiper arm angle.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Sudden Power Loss When Turning Sharp Left — Low Fuel Pickup
phContext: Cars running tank nearly empty (<1/8 tank) on winding mountain roads
symptoms: Engine sputters/stalls on long curves, runs fine straight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Fill tank above 1/4! (Running on fumes overheats in-tank fuel pump and starves pickup!). 2. Inspect baffle tray inside fuel tank if issue happens at 1/2 tank.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Battery Warning Light Flickers Over Puddles — Missing Splash Shield
phContext: Sedans/MPVs with torn lower engine under-cover
symptoms: Belt slips off alternator briefly when hitting puddle, battery light flashes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect lower plastic splash shield in right wheel well covering crank/alternator pulleys. 2. Reinstall splash shield and replace glazed serpentine belt.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Aftermarket Mud Tires Rubbing ABS / Brake Hose at Full Lock
phContext: Lifted pickups (Hilux, Ranger, Montero) with oversized 285/70R17 tires
symptoms: ABS light or brake fluid leak after off-road turn
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn steering wheel full lock left & right while inspecting clearance between tire lugs, upper control arm, ABS wire, and brake hose! 2. Reroute/zip-tie lines clear and adjust offset.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Engine Rattles 2 Seconds on Morning Start — Cheap Oil Filter Drainback
phContext: Cars using cheap aftermarket oil filters without silicone anti-drainback valve
symptoms: Loud timing chain/lifter clatter every morning for 2 sec
diagnosticSteps: 1. Oil drains out of filter overnight when anti-drainback flap leaks! 2. Replace with genuine OEM oil filter (silicone ADBV) and proper 5W-30/0W-20 oil. 3. Verify oil pressure builds <1 sec.

domainName: Intermittent, Mechanical-Electrical Crossover & Post-Repair Calibration Faults
title: Intermittent Fault Only in Customer's Hands — Capture Freeze Frame
phContext: Elusive intermittent electrical/stall complaints
symptoms: Runs flawlessly at shop, dies on customer's commute
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never clear codes blindly! Record ALL Freeze-Frame data (RPM, Load, ECT, Speed, Voltage, Fuel Trim) and Mode $06 misfires first. 2. Replicate exact thermal/traffic/A/C load conditions. 3. Wiggle-test harnesses while graphing PIDs.
